92	ERROR_LINE = re.compile(r"^(?!\s*(?:PASS|ok)\b).*(?:error:|error\[|FAILED|(?:^|\s)FAIL\b|panicked"
93	                        r"|Fatal error|\*\*\*)")

99	def wants(step, path):
100	    """Whether `path` (ROOT-relative, `/`-separated) is one of the step's inputs."""
101	    if path in ALWAYS:
102	        return True
103	    if path.startswith(EXCLUDED):
104	        return False
105	    roots, kept_md = STEP_INPUTS[step]
106	    if path.endswith(".md") and not path.startswith(kept_md) and MUTANT != "md-counted":
107	        return False
108	    return any(root == "" or path == root or path.startswith(root + "/") for root in roots)
109	
110	
111	def step_hash(step, digests, tools):
112	    """sha256 over the step's files' (path, digest) and the tool fingerprint."""
113	    files = [[path, digests[path]] for path in sorted(digests) if wants(step, path)]
114	    document = {"step": step, "files": files}
115	    if MUTANT != "no-tools":
116	        document["tools"] = tools
117	    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
118

120	def record(state, step, before, after):
121	    """Stamp the pass only when the inputs did not change while the step ran."""
122	    if before != after and MUTANT != "stamp-always":
123	        return False
124	    state[step] = before
125	    return True

129	    """None when the log is a clean typecheck, else the lines that say why not."""

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Issue batch B88 phase 4 — `make gate`, the one Full verification command.
`tools/proof/README.md`'s "The gate (gate.py)" is the long form.

    python3 tools/proof/gate.py [--force] [--wait SECONDS]
    python3 tools/proof/gate.py --selftest | --mutant no-tools|stamp-always|md-counted|warning-count

Six steps, serially, stopping at the first failure: `names`
(`name_residue.py`, spec §11 NM-8: no line or path spells the old name
outside its allow-list; every file is its input, `*.md` included), `typecheck` (`make
typecheck`, which builds or reuses the bundled encoders first, `make codecs`, spec §11
CX-5, passing only with no `error:` and exactly TYPECHECK_BASELINE's
warnings, by file and message; `tools/codecs` is among its and `app`'s inputs, and
`cmake --version` in the tool fingerprint), `fmt` (`cargo fmt --check` in core, graphic,
mcp-proxy), `lint` (`make lint`), `test` (`make test`) and `app` (`make app`,
then dist_check's D25 and D26 over the Release app: its entitlements and its
seal, the defect a no-op build once shipped and only `make dist` read).

A step is skipped when its hash equals its last pass. The hash is sha256
over the content of the step's own files among `git ls-files -co
--exclude-standard` (STEP_INPUTS; `gate.py` and the `Makefile` in every
step) and a tool fingerprint (TOOLS' output). It is taken before the step and
again after it, and the pass is stamped only when the two are equal, so a
step whose inputs changed while it ran runs again next time. Writes go only
under `build/gate/`: `lock`, `state.json`, `<step>.log`, `times.tsv`. Exit 0
PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 BLOCKED (another gate holds the lock past `--wait`).

A `--mutant` runs the selftest alone and must fail exactly its rows:
`no-tools` (the fingerprint left out of the hash) H2; `stamp-always` (a pass
stamped with unequal hashes) H3; `md-counted` (every `*.md` an input) M4 M5
M6; `warning-count` (warnings compared by count, not file and message) W2.
"""

import argparse
import collections
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = "tools/proof/gate.py"
GATE = ROOT / "build/gate"
ALWAYS = (HERE, "Makefile")
STEPS = ("names", "typecheck", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app")
BOUNDS = {"names": 120, "typecheck": 600, "fmt": 120, "lint": 600, "test": 900, "app": 1500}
COMMANDS = {
    "names": [["python3", "tools/proof/name_residue.py"]],
    "typecheck": [["make", "typecheck"]],
    "fmt": [["cargo", "fmt", "--check"]] * 3,
    "lint": [["make", "lint"]],
    "test": [["make", "test"]],
    "app": [["make", "app"]],
}
FOLDERS = {"fmt": ("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy")}
# The step's own files: folders and files, then which `*.md` count (none, unless named).
STEP_INPUTS = {
    "names": (("",), ("",)),
    "typecheck": (("app/Sources", "app/Bridging", "core/include", "agent", "tools/codecs"), ()),
    "fmt": (("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy"), ()),
    "lint": (("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy"), ()),
    "test": (("",), ("designs/spec/", "docs/")),
    "app": (("app", "agent", "core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy", "tools/codecs", "project.yml",
             "VERSION",
             "docs/graphics-api.md", "docs/graphics-api.d.ts", "tools/proof/dist_check.py"),
            ("docs/graphics-api.md",)),
}
EXCLUDED = ("archive/", ".secrets/")
TOOLS = (["xcrun", "swiftc", "--version"], ["xcodebuild", "-version"],
         ["xcrun", "--show-sdk-path"], ["rustc", "-Vv"], ["cargo", "clippy", "-V"],
         ["bun", "--version"], ["xcodegen", "--version"], ["cargo", "fmt", "--version"],
         ["cmake", "--version"])
# `make typecheck`'s warnings at HEAD 0b380d2, verbatim (CLAUDE.md: "0 errors and 4 warnings",
# deliberate, spec §11 W-8): (file basename, message). A fifth, or one gone, fails the step.
TYPECHECK_BASELINE = (
    ("Exporter.swift", "'copyCGImage(at:actualTime:)' was deprecated in macOS 15.0: Use "
     "generateCGImageAsynchronouslyForTime:completionHandler: instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
    ("CompositionBuilder.swift", "'tracks(withMediaType:)' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
     "loadTracks(withMediaType:) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
    ("CompositionBuilder.swift", "'timeRange' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
     "load(.timeRange) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
    ("CompositionBuilder+Orientation.swift", "'preferredTransform' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
     "load(.preferredTransform) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
)
DIAGNOSTIC = re.compile(r"^(?P<path>[^\s:][^:]*):\d+(?::\d+)?: (?P<kind>warning|error): (?P<msg>.*)$")
ERROR_LINE = re.compile(r"^(?!\s*(?:PASS|ok)\b).*(?:error:|error\[|FAILED|(?:^|\s)FAIL\b|panicked"
                        r"|Fatal error|\*\*\*)")
EXPECTED = {"no-tools": {"H2"}, "stamp-always": {"H3"}, "md-counted": {"M4", "M5", "M6"},
            "warning-count": {"W2"}}
MUTANT = None


def wants(step, path):
    """Whether `path` (ROOT-relative, `/`-separated) is one of the step's inputs."""
    if path in ALWAYS:
        return True
    if path.startswith(EXCLUDED):
        return False
    roots, kept_md = STEP_INPUTS[step]
    if path.endswith(".md") and not path.startswith(kept_md) and MUTANT != "md-counted":
        return False
    return any(root == "" or path == root or path.startswith(root + "/") for root in roots)


def step_hash(step, digests, tools):
    """sha256 over the step's files' (path, digest) and the tool fingerprint."""
    files = [[path, digests[path]] for path in sorted(digests) if wants(step, path)]
    document = {"step": step, "files": files}
    if MUTANT != "no-tools":
        document["tools"] = tools
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()


def record(state, step, before, after):
    """Stamp the pass only when the inputs did not change while the step ran."""
    if before != after and MUTANT != "stamp-always":
        return False
    state[step] = before
    return True


def typecheck_verdict(text, returncode):
    """None when the log is a clean typecheck, else the lines that say why not."""
    found, errors = [], []
    for line in text.splitlines():
        match = DIAGNOSTIC.match(line)
        if match and match["kind"] == "error":
            errors.append(line)
        elif match:
            found.append((os.path.basename(match["path"]), match["msg"]))
    if MUTANT == "warning-count":
        same = len(found) == len(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
    else:
        same = collections.Counter(found) == collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
    if returncode == 0 and not errors and same:
        return None
    lines = errors[:5] or ([] if returncode == 0 else [f"make typecheck exit {returncode}"])
    if not same:
        extra = collections.Counter(found) - collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
        gone = collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE) - collections.Counter(found)
        lines += [f"new warning: {name}: {message}" for name, message in extra.elements()]
        lines += [f"baseline warning gone: {name}: {message}" for name, message in gone.elements()]
    return lines[:4] + [f"see build/gate/typecheck.log; the baseline is TYPECHECK_BASELINE in {HERE}"]


def tree_digests():
    """{path: sha256 of its content} over `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard`."""
    listed = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=ROOT,
                            capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode().split("\0")
    digests = {}
    for path in filter(None, listed):
        if path.startswith(".secrets/"):
            continue
        full = ROOT / path
        try:
            if full.is_symlink():
                digests[path] = "link:" + os.readlink(full)
            else:
                digests[path] = hashlib.sha256(full.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        except OSError as error:
            digests[path] = f"unreadable: {error.strerror}"
    return digests


def fingerprint():
    out = []
    for argv in TOOLS:
        try:
            done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
            out.append(f"$ {' '.join(argv)} (exit {done.returncode})\n{done.stdout}{done.stderr}")
        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
            out.append(f"$ {' '.join(argv)}: {type(error).__name__}")
    return "\n".join(out)


def child_env():
    keys = ("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "RC_ASSEMBLYAI_KEY")
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in keys}


def run_step(step, log):
    """(ok, the lines that say why not) for one step, its output in `log`; bounded."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + BOUNDS[step]
    for index, argv in enumerate(COMMANDS[step]):
        cwd = ROOT / FOLDERS[step][index] if step in FOLDERS else ROOT
        log.write(f"$ (cd {cwd.relative_to(ROOT) or '.'}) {' '.join(argv)}\n")
        log.flush()
        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=child_env(), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                 stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=max(1.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait()
            return False, [f"ran past its {BOUNDS[step]} s bound"]
        finally:
            if child.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        if step == "typecheck":
            log.flush()
            why = typecheck_verdict(Path(log.name).read_text(errors="replace"), child.returncode)
            return why is None, why or []
        if child.returncode != 0:
            log.flush()
            text = Path(log.name).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
            lines = [line for line in text if ERROR_LINE.search(line)][:5] or text[-5:]
            return False, lines
    return release_signature(log) if step == "app" else (True, [])


def release_signature(log):
    """dist_check's D25 and D26 over the Release app `make app` just built."""
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools/proof"))
    import dist_check  # noqa: E402 — the app step alone reads it
    import proof_app  # noqa: E402

    exe = str(proof_app.executable(dist_check.DEFAULT_RELEASE))
    rows = (("D25 the Release app's entitlements are exactly audio-input, camera and "
             "get-task-allow",
             dist_check.entitlements(os.path.realpath(exe), dist_check.RELEASE_ENTITLEMENTS)),
            ("D26 the Release app passes codesign --verify --deep --strict",
             dist_check.sealed(exe)))
    failed = []
    for name, (ok, detail) in rows:
        log.write(f"gate: {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name}{'' if ok else ': ' + detail}\n")
        if not ok:
            failed.append(f"{name}: {detail}")
    return not failed, failed


def take_lock(wait):
    GATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle = open(GATE / "lock", "w")
    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait
    while True:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            return handle
        except BlockingIOError:
            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                handle.close()
                return None
            time.sleep(0.5)


def commit_label():
    head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT,
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or "none"
    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=ROOT,
                           capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return head + ("-dirty" if dirty else "")


def gate(force, wait):
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGHUP):  # through run_step's finally: kill the group
        signal.signal(sig, lambda n, _f: sys.exit(128 + n))
    started = time.monotonic()
    lock = take_lock(wait)
    if lock is None:
        print("gate: BLOCKED (build/gate/lock)", flush=True)
        return 3
    state_path = GATE / "state.json"
    try:
        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text())
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        state = {}
    commit, unstamped = commit_label(), []
    tools, digests = fingerprint(), tree_digests()
    with open(GATE / "times.tsv", "a") as times:
        for step in STEPS:
            begun = time.monotonic()
            before = step_hash(step, digests, tools)
            if not force and state.get(step) == before:
                result = "skip"
                print(f"gate: {step} skip {time.monotonic() - begun:.0f}s", flush=True)
            else:
                with open(GATE / f"{step}.log", "w") as log:
                    ok, why = run_step(step, log)
                tools, digests = fingerprint(), tree_digests()
                after = step_hash(step, digests, tools)
                result = "pass" if ok else "FAIL"
                print(f"gate: {step} {result} {time.monotonic() - begun:.0f}s", flush=True)
                for line in why[:5]:
                    print(f"    {line.strip()[:300]}", flush=True)
                if ok and record(state, step, before, after):
                    tmp = state_path.with_suffix(f".tmp-{os.getpid()}")
                    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
                    os.replace(tmp, state_path)
                elif ok:
                    unstamped.append(step)
                    result = "pass-unstamped"
                    print(f"gate: {step} pass, not stamped: its inputs changed while it ran",
                          flush=True)
            utc = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
            times.write(f"{utc}\t{commit}\t{step}\t{time.monotonic() - begun:.1f}\t{result}\n")
            times.flush()
            if result == "FAIL":
                print(f"gate: FAIL {step} {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s", flush=True)
                return 1
    tail = f" (not stamped: {', '.join(unstamped)})" if unstamped else ""
    print(f"gate: PASS {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s{tail}", flush=True)
    return 0


def selftest(mutant=None):
    global MUTANT
    MUTANT, results = mutant, []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    # One file of each input class, and the steps a substituted digest must move.
    every = set(STEPS)
    classes = [
        ("M1", "app/Sources/Clip.swift", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
        ("M1", "app/Bridging/x.h", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
        ("M1", "core/include/framejob_core.h", every),
        ("M1", "agent/src/agent.ts", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
        ("M8", "tools/codecs/build_codecs.py", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
        ("M2", "core/src/lib.rs", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
        ("M2", "graphic/src/lib.rs", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
        ("M2", "mcp-proxy/Cargo.toml", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "project.yml", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "VERSION", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "app/Resources/Shaders/Compositor.metal", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "docs/graphics-api.md", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "docs/graphics-api.d.ts", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "tools/proof/dist_check.py", {"names", "test", "app"}),
        ("M3", "tools/proof/mcp.py", {"names", "test"}),
        ("M3", "designs/spec/x.md", {"names", "test"}),
        ("M3", "docs/manual-checks.md", {"names", "test"}),
        ("M4", "archive/x.md", set()),
        ("M4", "archive/x.py", set()),
        ("M4", "README.md", {"names"}),
        ("M5", "core/CLAUDE.md", {"names"}),
        ("M5", "app/CLAUDE.md", {"names"}),
        ("M6", "designs/adr/x.md", {"names"}),
        ("M7", HERE, every),
        ("M7", "Makefile", every),
    ]
    base = {path: "0" * 64 for _, path, _ in classes}
    hashes = {step: step_hash(step, base, "tools") for step in STEPS}
    again = {step: step_hash(step, dict(base), "tools") for step in STEPS}
    state = {}
    stamped = all(record(state, step, hashes[step], again[step]) for step in STEPS)
    row("H0", hashes == again and stamped and state == hashes,
        "CONTROL: identical digests give identical hashes, and every step is stamped")
    for name, path, expected in classes:
        changed = dict(base, **{path: "1" * 64})
        moved = {step for step in STEPS if step_hash(step, changed, "tools") != hashes[step]}
        row(name, moved == expected, f"{path} moves {sorted(moved)}, expected {sorted(expected)}")
    moved = {step for step in STEPS if step_hash(step, base, "tools 2") != hashes[step]}
    row("H2", moved == every, f"a substituted tool string moves {sorted(moved)}")
    state = {"test": "old"}
    stamped = record(state, "test", hashes["test"], hashes["app"])
    row("H3", not stamped and state == {"test": "old"}, "unequal hashes record no pass")
    row("H4", all(step_hash(step, dict(base, **{".secrets/x": "2"}), "tools") == hashes[step]
                  for step in STEPS),
        "CONTROL: a .secrets/ path is in no step's inputs")

    def log(pairs, extra=""):
        lines = []
        for index, (name, message) in enumerate(pairs):
            lines += [f"app/Sources/{name}:{100 + index}:9: warning: {message}",
                      f"    |    `- warning: {message}"]
        return "\n".join(lines) + extra + "\n$ tsc --noEmit\n"

    row("W0", typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE), 0) is None,
        "CONTROL: the four baseline warnings, at any line, each with its caret line, pass")
    fifth = TYPECHECK_BASELINE + (("Clip.swift", "'x' was deprecated"),)
    why = typecheck_verdict(log(fifth), 0)
    row("W1", why is not None and any("Clip.swift" in line for line in why),
        f"a fifth warning fails, named: {why}")
    moved_file = (("Clip.swift", TYPECHECK_BASELINE[0][1]),) + TYPECHECK_BASELINE[1:]
    why = typecheck_verdict(log(moved_file), 0)
    row("W2", why is not None, f"a baseline warning in another file fails: {why}")
    why = typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE[1:]), 0)
    row("W3", why is not None, f"a baseline warning gone fails: {why}")
    why = typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE, "\napp/Sources/A.swift:1:1: error: nope"), 1)
    row("W4", why is not None and "error: nope" in why[0], f"an error fails, first: {why}")

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="make gate (B88 phase 4)")
    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="run every step")
    parser.add_argument("--wait", type=float, default=120.0,
                        help="seconds to wait for another gate's lock (default 120)")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
        return selftest(args.mutant)
    return gate(args.force, args.wait)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

1	# Builds, signs (Developer ID), notarizes and publishes FrameJob.dmg as a
2	# GitHub Release on every push to the `publish` branch (spec §11 PUB-1..PUB-9).
3	# Rasterize's workflow, renamed, with three differences: the archive is the
4	# Distribution configuration (no dev tools, spec §11 V-1), the Metal toolchain
5	# is checked for, and the exported app is checked by
6	# tools/proof/published_check.py before it is packed. Beside the DMG goes a
7	# one-item appcast.xml, the stapled DMG's EdDSA signature in it, which every
8	# installed copy's Sparkle reads from the latest release (spec §11
9	# PUB-6..PUB-9, tools/proof/appcast.py).
10	#
11	# Version: "<VERSION file>.<run number>", build number = run number. The run
12	# counter belongs to this file — renaming or recreating it restarts numbering,
13	# so leave the name alone. A re-run keeps its run number and replaces the
14	# release's DMG and appcast rather than failing, and leaves Latest alone; a
15	# run that creates an older release than the current Latest creates it with
16	# --latest=false, so Latest is always the highest run number (PUB-6).
17	#
18	# Secrets (in the `publish` environment, restricted to the `publish` branch):
19	#   DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64, DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD, KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD,
20	#   APPLE_TEAM_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64,
21	#   SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY (the owner's EdDSA private key, `generate_keys -x`
22	#   output, spec §11 PUB-8; the first step fails without it)
23	name: Publish
24	
25	on:
26	  push:
27	    branches: [publish]
28	
29	concurrency:
30	  group: publish
31	  cancel-in-progress: false
32	
33	permissions:
34	  contents: write
35	
36	jobs:
37	  publish:
38	    runs-on: macos-26
39	    environment: publish
40	    timeout-minutes: 60
41	    steps:
42	      # Nothing ships unsigned (spec §11 PUB-8): without the update key the run
43	      # stops here, before anything is built or signed.
44	      - name: Check the update key
45	        env:
46	          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
47	        run: |
48	          if ! [ -n "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
49	            echo "::error::The publish environment has no SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY secret (spec §11 PUB-8)"
50	            exit 1
51	          fi
52	
53	      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
54	
55	      - name: Toolchain
56	        run: |
57	          xcodebuild -version
58	          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
59	          rustup default stable
60	          rustc --version
61	          brew install xcodegen
62	          # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-5): Xcode's "Build Codecs" step
63	          # fetches the pinned tarballs and builds them with cmake, which a
64	          # runner image may or may not carry; the system perl is enough.
65	          command -v cmake >/dev/null || brew install cmake
66	          cmake --version
67	          # Compositor.metal is compiled by the build, and Xcode 26 ships the
68	          # Metal toolchain as a separate component an image may not carry.
69	          if ! xcrun metal --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
70	            xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain
71	          fi
72	          xcrun metal --version
73	
74	      # Builds the assistant's agent helper (agent/) in the Xcode post-build step.
75	      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
76	
77	      # core/ builds graphic/ as a path dependency; mcp-proxy/ is framejob-mcp.
78	      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
79	        with:
80	          workspaces: |
81	            core
82	            mcp-proxy
83	
84	      - name: Compute paths and version
85	        run: |
86	          # The runner context isn't available in job-level env, so the paths
87	          # under RUNNER_TEMP are exported here for the later steps.
88	          {
89	            echo "KEYCHAIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
90	            echo "ARCHIVE=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.xcarchive"
91	            echo "EXPORT=$RUNNER_TEMP/export"
92	            echo "DMG=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.dmg"
93	            echo "APPCAST=$RUNNER_TEMP/appcast.xml"
94	            echo "ED_KEY=$RUNNER_TEMP/sparkle_ed_key"
95	          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
96	          BASE="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)"
97	          # macOS versions are at most three integers; the run number is the third.
98	          if ! [[ "$BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
99	            echo "::error::VERSION must be MAJOR.MINOR, got '$BASE'"
100	            exit 1
101	          fi
102	          echo "VERSION=$BASE.$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
103	          echo "BUILD_NUMBER=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
104	
105	      - name: Import signing certificate
106	        env:
107	          P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64 }}
108	          P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD }}
109	          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
110	        run: |
111	          P12="$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12"
112	          echo "$P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$P12"
113	          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
114	          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
115	          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
116	          security import "$P12" -P "$P12_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
117	          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN" > /dev/null
118	          # Put the signing keychain in the search list so xcodebuild and codesign find it.
119	          # The existing entries are split on purpose; runner keychain paths have no spaces.
120	          # shellcheck disable=SC2046
121	          security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN" $(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"')
122	          rm "$P12"
123	          security find-identity -v -p codesigning "$KEYCHAIN"
124	
125	      # Distribution is the configuration that ships (spec §11 V-1): Release
126	      # without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS, and without the get-task-allow notarization
127	      # refuses. The two helpers are signed by their own build steps with the
128	      # identity given here, before Xcode signs the app around them.
129	      - name: Archive
130	        env:
131	          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
132	        run: |
133	          make project
134	          xcodebuild archive \
135	            -project FrameJob.xcodeproj -scheme FrameJob -configuration Distribution \
136	            -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' \
137	            -derivedDataPath build \
138	            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
139	            CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
140	            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Developer ID Application" \
141	            DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$TEAM_ID" \
142	            OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS=--timestamp \
143	            MARKETING_VERSION="$VERSION" \
144	            CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$BUILD_NUMBER"
145	
146	      # published_check.py holds what notarization does not look at: no dev
147	      # tools, each binary's exact entitlements after the export's re-sign, the
148	      # catalog snapshot, the two version numbers, and the updater: Sparkle's
149	      # framework and helpers signed with the app's team and the hardened
150	      # runtime, the feed and a 32-byte EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-8).
151	      - name: Export
152	        run: |
153	          xcodebuild -exportArchive \
154	            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
155	            -exportOptionsPlist .github/ExportOptions.plist \
156	            -exportPath "$EXPORT"
157	          APP="$EXPORT/Frame Job.app"
158	          codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
159	          codesign -dvv "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E '^(Authority|TeamIdentifier|Timestamp|Runtime)'
160	          python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$APP" \
161	            --version "$VERSION" --build "$BUILD_NUMBER"
162	
163	      - name: Build DMG
164	        run: |
165	          STAGE="$RUNNER_TEMP/dmg"
166	          mkdir -p "$STAGE"
167	          cp -R "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" "$STAGE/"
168	          ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
169	          # hdiutil's own estimate of the scratch volume from -srcfolder now
170	          # and then comes out short ("No space left on device" copying the
171	          # helper), so the size is the staged folder's plus a quarter and
172	          # 64 MB; UDZO compresses the free space away.
173	          SIZE_MB=$(( $(du -sm "$STAGE" | cut -f1) * 5 / 4 + 64 ))
174	          hdiutil create -volname "Frame Job" -srcfolder "$STAGE" -size "${SIZE_MB}m" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"
175	          codesign --sign "Developer ID Application" --timestamp --keychain "$KEYCHAIN" "$DMG"
176	
177	      - name: Notarize
178	        env:
179	          ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
180	          ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
181	          ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
182	        run: |
183	          KEY="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
184	          echo "$ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$KEY"
185	          AUTH=(--key "$KEY" --key-id "$ASC_KEY_ID" --issuer "$ASC_ISSUER_ID")
186	          OUT="$(xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" "${AUTH[@]}" --wait --timeout 30m --output-format json)"
187	          echo "$OUT"
188	          ID="$(jq -r .id <<< "$OUT")"
189	          STATUS="$(jq -r .status <<< "$OUT")"
190	          if [ "$STATUS" != "Accepted" ]; then
191	            xcrun notarytool log "$ID" "${AUTH[@]}" || true
192	            echo "::error::Notarization finished with status '$STATUS'"
193	            exit 1
194	          fi
195	          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
196	          xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
197	          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG"
198	
199	      # The EdDSA signature is made over the stapled DMG, the bytes the release
200	      # serves (spec §11 PUB-8). sign_update is the Sparkle package's own, from
201	      # the archive's package resolution; the key reaches it only as a 0600
202	      # file, removed straight after (and by the clean-up step on a failure).
203	      - name: Sign the update and write the appcast
204	        env:
205	          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
206	        run: |
207	          COUNT="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
208	          if [ "$COUNT" != 1 ]; then
209	            echo "::error::Expected one sign_update under build/SourcePackages/artifacts, found $COUNT"
210	            exit 1
211	          fi
212	          SIGN_UPDATE="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f)"
213	          umask 077; printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$ED_KEY"
214	          python3 tools/proof/appcast.py write \
215	            --app "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" \
216	            --dmg "$DMG" \
217	            --sign-update "$SIGN_UPDATE" \
218	            --key-file "$ED_KEY" \
219	            --url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/v$VERSION/FrameJob.dmg" \
220	            --notes-url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/v$VERSION" \
221	            --out "$APPCAST"
222	          rm -f "$ED_KEY"
223	
224	      - name: Publish release
225	        env:
226	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
227	        run: |
228	          TAG="v$VERSION"
229	          if gh release view "$TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
230	            # A re-run: both assets replaced, Latest left alone (spec §11 PUB-6).
231	            gh release upload "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" --clobber
232	          else
233	            # The feed is releases/latest/download/appcast.xml, so Latest is
234	            # always the highest run number (spec §11 PUB-6): a release older
235	            # than the current Latest (an old run re-run) is not made Latest.
236	            LATEST="$(gh release view --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null || true)"
237	            MAKE_LATEST="--latest"
238	            if [ -n "$LATEST" ] && [ "${LATEST##*.}" -gt "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" ] 2> /dev/null; then
239	              MAKE_LATEST="--latest=false"
240	            fi
241	            gh release create "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" \
242	              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
243	              --title "Frame Job $VERSION" \
244	              --generate-notes \
245	              "$MAKE_LATEST"
246	          fi
247	
248	      - name: Clean up signing material
249	        if: always()
250	        run: |
251	          security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN" 2> /dev/null || true
252	          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12" "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" "$ED_KEY"

# is checked for, and the exported app is checked by
# tools/proof/published_check.py before it is packed. Beside the DMG goes a
# one-item appcast.xml, the stapled DMG's EdDSA signature in it, which every
# installed copy's Sparkle reads from the latest release (spec §11
# PUB-6..PUB-9, tools/proof/appcast.py).
#
# Version: "<VERSION file>.<run number>", build number = run number. The run
# counter belongs to this file — renaming or recreating it restarts numbering,
# so leave the name alone. A re-run keeps its run number and replaces the
# release's DMG and appcast rather than failing, and leaves Latest alone; a
# run that creates an older release than the current Latest creates it with
# --latest=false, so Latest is always the highest run number (PUB-6).
#
# Secrets (in the `publish` environment, restricted to the `publish` branch):
#   DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64, DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD, KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD,
#   APPLE_TEAM_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64,
#   SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY (the owner's EdDSA private key, `generate_keys -x`
#   output, spec §11 PUB-8; the first step fails without it)
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [publish]

concurrency:
  group: publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: macos-26
    environment: publish
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      # Nothing ships unsigned (spec §11 PUB-8): without the update key the run
      # stops here, before anything is built or signed.
      - name: Check the update key
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          if ! [ -n "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
            echo "::error::The publish environment has no SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY secret (spec §11 PUB-8)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Toolchain
        run: |
          xcodebuild -version
          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
          rustup default stable
          rustc --version
          brew install xcodegen
          # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-5): Xcode's "Build Codecs" step
          # fetches the pinned tarballs and builds them with cmake, which a
          # runner image may or may not carry; the system perl is enough.
          command -v cmake >/dev/null || brew install cmake
          cmake --version
          # Compositor.metal is compiled by the build, and Xcode 26 ships the
          # Metal toolchain as a separate component an image may not carry.
          if ! xcrun metal --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain
          fi
          xcrun metal --version

      # Builds the assistant's agent helper (agent/) in the Xcode post-build step.
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2

      # core/ builds graphic/ as a path dependency; mcp-proxy/ is framejob-mcp.
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: |
            core
            mcp-proxy

      - name: Compute paths and version
        run: |
          # The runner context isn't available in job-level env, so the paths
          # under RUNNER_TEMP are exported here for the later steps.
          {
            echo "KEYCHAIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
            echo "ARCHIVE=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.xcarchive"
            echo "EXPORT=$RUNNER_TEMP/export"
            echo "DMG=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.dmg"
            echo "APPCAST=$RUNNER_TEMP/appcast.xml"
            echo "ED_KEY=$RUNNER_TEMP/sparkle_ed_key"
          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          BASE="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)"
          # macOS versions are at most three integers; the run number is the third.
          if ! [[ "$BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::VERSION must be MAJOR.MINOR, got '$BASE'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "VERSION=$BASE.$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "BUILD_NUMBER=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Import signing certificate
        env:
          P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64 }}
          P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          P12="$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12"
          echo "$P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$P12"
          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
          security import "$P12" -P "$P12_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN" > /dev/null
          # Put the signing keychain in the search list so xcodebuild and codesign find it.
          # The existing entries are split on purpose; runner keychain paths have no spaces.
          # shellcheck disable=SC2046
          security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN" $(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"')
          rm "$P12"
          security find-identity -v -p codesigning "$KEYCHAIN"

      # Distribution is the configuration that ships (spec §11 V-1): Release
      # without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS, and without the get-task-allow notarization
      # refuses. The two helpers are signed by their own build steps with the
      # identity given here, before Xcode signs the app around them.
      - name: Archive
        env:
          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          make project
          xcodebuild archive \
            -project FrameJob.xcodeproj -scheme FrameJob -configuration Distribution \
            -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' \
            -derivedDataPath build \
            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
            CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Developer ID Application" \
            DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$TEAM_ID" \
            OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS=--timestamp \
            MARKETING_VERSION="$VERSION" \
            CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$BUILD_NUMBER"

      # published_check.py holds what notarization does not look at: no dev
      # tools, each binary's exact entitlements after the export's re-sign, the
      # catalog snapshot, the two version numbers, and the updater: Sparkle's
      # framework and helpers signed with the app's team and the hardened
      # runtime, the feed and a 32-byte EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-8).
      - name: Export
        run: |
          xcodebuild -exportArchive \
            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
            -exportOptionsPlist .github/ExportOptions.plist \
            -exportPath "$EXPORT"
          APP="$EXPORT/Frame Job.app"
          codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
          codesign -dvv "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E '^(Authority|TeamIdentifier|Timestamp|Runtime)'
          python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$APP" \
            --version "$VERSION" --build "$BUILD_NUMBER"

      - name: Build DMG
        run: |
          STAGE="$RUNNER_TEMP/dmg"
          mkdir -p "$STAGE"
          cp -R "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" "$STAGE/"
          ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
          # hdiutil's own estimate of the scratch volume from -srcfolder now
          # and then comes out short ("No space left on device" copying the
          # helper), so the size is the staged folder's plus a quarter and
          # 64 MB; UDZO compresses the free space away.
          SIZE_MB=$(( $(du -sm "$STAGE" | cut -f1) * 5 / 4 + 64 ))
          hdiutil create -volname "Frame Job" -srcfolder "$STAGE" -size "${SIZE_MB}m" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"
          codesign --sign "Developer ID Application" --timestamp --keychain "$KEYCHAIN" "$DMG"

      - name: Notarize
        env:
          ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
          ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
          ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          KEY="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
          echo "$ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$KEY"
          AUTH=(--key "$KEY" --key-id "$ASC_KEY_ID" --issuer "$ASC_ISSUER_ID")
          OUT="$(xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" "${AUTH[@]}" --wait --timeout 30m --output-format json)"
          echo "$OUT"
          ID="$(jq -r .id <<< "$OUT")"
          STATUS="$(jq -r .status <<< "$OUT")"
          if [ "$STATUS" != "Accepted" ]; then
            xcrun notarytool log "$ID" "${AUTH[@]}" || true
            echo "::error::Notarization finished with status '$STATUS'"
            exit 1
          fi
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
          xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG"

      # The EdDSA signature is made over the stapled DMG, the bytes the release
      # serves (spec §11 PUB-8). sign_update is the Sparkle package's own, from
      # the archive's package resolution; the key reaches it only as a 0600
      # file, removed straight after (and by the clean-up step on a failure).
      - name: Sign the update and write the appcast
        env:
          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          COUNT="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
          if [ "$COUNT" != 1 ]; then
            echo "::error::Expected one sign_update under build/SourcePackages/artifacts, found $COUNT"
            exit 1
          fi
          SIGN_UPDATE="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f)"
          umask 077; printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$ED_KEY"
          python3 tools/proof/appcast.py write \
            --app "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" \
            --dmg "$DMG" \
            --sign-update "$SIGN_UPDATE" \
            --key-file "$ED_KEY" \
            --url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/v$VERSION/FrameJob.dmg" \
            --notes-url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/v$VERSION" \
            --out "$APPCAST"
          rm -f "$ED_KEY"

      - name: Publish release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          TAG="v$VERSION"
          if gh release view "$TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            # A re-run: both assets replaced, Latest left alone (spec §11 PUB-6).
            gh release upload "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" --clobber
          else
            # The feed is releases/latest/download/appcast.xml, so Latest is
            # always the highest run number (spec §11 PUB-6): a release older
            # than the current Latest (an old run re-run) is not made Latest.
            LATEST="$(gh release view --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null || true)"
            MAKE_LATEST="--latest"
            if [ -n "$LATEST" ] && [ "${LATEST##*.}" -gt "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" ] 2> /dev/null; then
              MAKE_LATEST="--latest=false"
            fi
            gh release create "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" \
              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
              --title "Frame Job $VERSION" \
              --generate-notes \
              "$MAKE_LATEST"
          fi

      - name: Clean up signing material
        if: always()
        run: |
          security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN" 2> /dev/null || true
          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12" "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" "$ED_KEY"

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Issue batch B88 phase 4 — `make gate`, the one Full verification command.
3	`tools/proof/README.md`'s "The gate (gate.py)" is the long form.
4	
5	    python3 tools/proof/gate.py [--force] [--wait SECONDS]
6	    python3 tools/proof/gate.py --selftest | --mutant no-tools|stamp-always|md-counted|warning-count
7	
8	Six steps, serially, stopping at the first failure: `names`
9	(`name_residue.py`, spec §11 NM-8: no line or path spells the old name
10	outside its allow-list; every file is its input, `*.md` included), `typecheck` (`make
11	typecheck`, which builds or reuses the bundled encoders first, `make codecs`, spec §11
12	CX-5, passing only with no `error:` and exactly TYPECHECK_BASELINE's
13	warnings, by file and message; `tools/codecs` is among its and `app`'s inputs, and
14	`cmake --version` in the tool fingerprint), `fmt` (`cargo fmt --check` in core, graphic,
15	mcp-proxy), `lint` (`make lint`), `test` (`make test`) and `app` (`make app`,
16	then dist_check's D25 and D26 over the Release app: its entitlements and its
17	seal, the defect a no-op build once shipped and only `make dist` read).
18	
19	A step is skipped when its hash equals its last pass. The hash is sha256
20	over the content of the step's own files among `git ls-files -co
21	--exclude-standard` (STEP_INPUTS; `gate.py` and the `Makefile` in every
22	step) and a tool fingerprint (TOOLS' output). It is taken before the step and
23	again after it, and the pass is stamped only when the two are equal, so a
24	step whose inputs changed while it ran runs again next time. Writes go only
25	under `build/gate/`: `lock`, `state.json`, `<step>.log`, `times.tsv`. Exit 0
26	PASS, 1 FAIL, 3 BLOCKED (another gate holds the lock past `--wait`).
27	
28	A `--mutant` runs the selftest alone and must fail exactly its rows:
29	`no-tools` (the fingerprint left out of the hash) H2; `stamp-always` (a pass
30	stamped with unequal hashes) H3; `md-counted` (every `*.md` an input) M4 M5
31	M6; `warning-count` (warnings compared by count, not file and message) W2.
32	"""
33	
34	import argparse
35	import collections
36	import fcntl
37	import hashlib
38	import json
39	import os
40	import re
41	import signal
42	import subprocess
43	import sys
44	import time
45	from pathlib import Path
46	
47	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
48	HERE = "tools/proof/gate.py"
49	GATE = ROOT / "build/gate"
50	ALWAYS = (HERE, "Makefile")
51	STEPS = ("names", "typecheck", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app")
52	BOUNDS = {"names": 120, "typecheck": 600, "fmt": 120, "lint": 600, "test": 900, "app": 1500}
53	COMMANDS = {
54	    "names": [["python3", "tools/proof/name_residue.py"]],
55	    "typecheck": [["make", "typecheck"]],
56	    "fmt": [["cargo", "fmt", "--check"]] * 3,
57	    "lint": [["make", "lint"]],
58	    "test": [["make", "test"]],
59	    "app": [["make", "app"]],
60	}
61	FOLDERS = {"fmt": ("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy")}
62	# The step's own files: folders and files, then which `*.md` count (none, unless named).
63	STEP_INPUTS = {
64	    "names": (("",), ("",)),
65	    "typecheck": (("app/Sources", "app/Bridging", "core/include", "agent", "tools/codecs"), ()),
66	    "fmt": (("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy"), ()),
67	    "lint": (("core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy"), ()),
68	    "test": (("",), ("designs/spec/", "docs/")),
69	    "app": (("app", "agent", "core", "graphic", "mcp-proxy", "tools/codecs", "project.yml",
70	             "VERSION",
71	             "docs/graphics-api.md", "docs/graphics-api.d.ts", "tools/proof/dist_check.py"),
72	            ("docs/graphics-api.md",)),
73	}
74	EXCLUDED = ("archive/", ".secrets/")
75	TOOLS = (["xcrun", "swiftc", "--version"], ["xcodebuild", "-version"],
76	         ["xcrun", "--show-sdk-path"], ["rustc", "-Vv"], ["cargo", "clippy", "-V"],
77	         ["bun", "--version"], ["xcodegen", "--version"], ["cargo", "fmt", "--version"],
78	         ["cmake", "--version"])
79	# `make typecheck`'s warnings at HEAD 0b380d2, verbatim (CLAUDE.md: "0 errors and 4 warnings",
80	# deliberate, spec §11 W-8): (file basename, message). A fifth, or one gone, fails the step.
81	TYPECHECK_BASELINE = (
82	    ("Exporter.swift", "'copyCGImage(at:actualTime:)' was deprecated in macOS 15.0: Use "
83	     "generateCGImageAsynchronouslyForTime:completionHandler: instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
84	    ("CompositionBuilder.swift", "'tracks(withMediaType:)' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
85	     "loadTracks(withMediaType:) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
86	    ("CompositionBuilder.swift", "'timeRange' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
87	     "load(.timeRange) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
88	    ("CompositionBuilder+Orientation.swift", "'preferredTransform' was deprecated in macOS 13.0: Use "
89	     "load(.preferredTransform) instead [#DeprecatedDeclaration]"),
90	)
91	DIAGNOSTIC = re.compile(r"^(?P<path>[^\s:][^:]*):\d+(?::\d+)?: (?P<kind>warning|error): (?P<msg>.*)$")
92	ERROR_LINE = re.compile(r"^(?!\s*(?:PASS|ok)\b).*(?:error:|error\[|FAILED|(?:^|\s)FAIL\b|panicked"
93	                        r"|Fatal error|\*\*\*)")
94	EXPECTED = {"no-tools": {"H2"}, "stamp-always": {"H3"}, "md-counted": {"M4", "M5", "M6"},
95	            "warning-count": {"W2"}}
96	MUTANT = None
97	
98	
99	def wants(step, path):
100	    """Whether `path` (ROOT-relative, `/`-separated) is one of the step's inputs."""
101	    if path in ALWAYS:
102	        return True
103	    if path.startswith(EXCLUDED):
104	        return False
105	    roots, kept_md = STEP_INPUTS[step]
106	    if path.endswith(".md") and not path.startswith(kept_md) and MUTANT != "md-counted":
107	        return False
108	    return any(root == "" or path == root or path.startswith(root + "/") for root in roots)
109	
110	
111	def step_hash(step, digests, tools):
112	    """sha256 over the step's files' (path, digest) and the tool fingerprint."""
113	    files = [[path, digests[path]] for path in sorted(digests) if wants(step, path)]
114	    document = {"step": step, "files": files}
115	    if MUTANT != "no-tools":
116	        document["tools"] = tools
117	    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(document, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
118	
119	
120	def record(state, step, before, after):
121	    """Stamp the pass only when the inputs did not change while the step ran."""
122	    if before != after and MUTANT != "stamp-always":
123	        return False
124	    state[step] = before
125	    return True
126	
127	
128	def typecheck_verdict(text, returncode):
129	    """None when the log is a clean typecheck, else the lines that say why not."""
130	    found, errors = [], []
131	    for line in text.splitlines():
132	        match = DIAGNOSTIC.match(line)
133	        if match and match["kind"] == "error":
134	            errors.append(line)
135	        elif match:
136	            found.append((os.path.basename(match["path"]), match["msg"]))
137	    if MUTANT == "warning-count":
138	        same = len(found) == len(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
139	    else:
140	        same = collections.Counter(found) == collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
141	    if returncode == 0 and not errors and same:
142	        return None
143	    lines = errors[:5] or ([] if returncode == 0 else [f"make typecheck exit {returncode}"])
144	    if not same:
145	        extra = collections.Counter(found) - collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE)
146	        gone = collections.Counter(TYPECHECK_BASELINE) - collections.Counter(found)
147	        lines += [f"new warning: {name}: {message}" for name, message in extra.elements()]
148	        lines += [f"baseline warning gone: {name}: {message}" for name, message in gone.elements()]
149	    return lines[:4] + [f"see build/gate/typecheck.log; the baseline is TYPECHECK_BASELINE in {HERE}"]
150	
151	
152	def tree_digests():
153	    """{path: sha256 of its content} over `git ls-files -co --exclude-standard`."""
154	    listed = subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files", "-co", "--exclude-standard", "-z"], cwd=ROOT,
155	                            capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode().split("\0")
156	    digests = {}
157	    for path in filter(None, listed):
158	        if path.startswith(".secrets/"):
159	            continue
160	        full = ROOT / path
161	        try:
162	            if full.is_symlink():
163	                digests[path] = "link:" + os.readlink(full)
164	            else:
165	                digests[path] = hashlib.sha256(full.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
166	        except OSError as error:
167	            digests[path] = f"unreadable: {error.strerror}"
168	    return digests
169	
170	
171	def fingerprint():
172	    out = []
173	    for argv in TOOLS:
174	        try:
175	            done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
176	            out.append(f"$ {' '.join(argv)} (exit {done.returncode})\n{done.stdout}{done.stderr}")
177	        except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as error:
178	            out.append(f"$ {' '.join(argv)}: {type(error).__name__}")
179	    return "\n".join(out)
180	
181	
182	def child_env():
183	    keys = ("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY", "RC_ASSEMBLYAI_KEY")
184	    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in keys}
185	
186	
187	def run_step(step, log):
188	    """(ok, the lines that say why not) for one step, its output in `log`; bounded."""
189	    deadline = time.monotonic() + BOUNDS[step]
190	    for index, argv in enumerate(COMMANDS[step]):
191	        cwd = ROOT / FOLDERS[step][index] if step in FOLDERS else ROOT
192	        log.write(f"$ (cd {cwd.relative_to(ROOT) or '.'}) {' '.join(argv)}\n")
193	        log.flush()
194	        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, env=child_env(), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
195	                                 stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
196	        try:
197	            child.wait(timeout=max(1.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
198	        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
199	            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
200	            child.wait()
201	            return False, [f"ran past its {BOUNDS[step]} s bound"]
202	        finally:
203	            if child.poll() is None:
204	                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
205	        if step == "typecheck":
206	            log.flush()
207	            why = typecheck_verdict(Path(log.name).read_text(errors="replace"), child.returncode)
208	            return why is None, why or []
209	        if child.returncode != 0:
210	            log.flush()
211	            text = Path(log.name).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
212	            lines = [line for line in text if ERROR_LINE.search(line)][:5] or text[-5:]
213	            return False, lines
214	    return release_signature(log) if step == "app" else (True, [])
215	
216	
217	def release_signature(log):
218	    """dist_check's D25 and D26 over the Release app `make app` just built."""
219	    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools/proof"))
220	    import dist_check  # noqa: E402 — the app step alone reads it
221	    import proof_app  # noqa: E402
222	
223	    exe = str(proof_app.executable(dist_check.DEFAULT_RELEASE))
224	    rows = (("D25 the Release app's entitlements are exactly audio-input, camera and "
225	             "get-task-allow",
226	             dist_check.entitlements(os.path.realpath(exe), dist_check.RELEASE_ENTITLEMENTS)),
227	            ("D26 the Release app passes codesign --verify --deep --strict",
228	             dist_check.sealed(exe)))
229	    failed = []
230	    for name, (ok, detail) in rows:
231	        log.write(f"gate: {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name}{'' if ok else ': ' + detail}\n")
232	        if not ok:
233	            failed.append(f"{name}: {detail}")
234	    return not failed, failed
235	
236	
237	def take_lock(wait):
238	    GATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
239	    handle = open(GATE / "lock", "w")
240	    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait
241	    while True:
242	        try:
243	            fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
244	            return handle
245	        except BlockingIOError:
246	            if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
247	                handle.close()
248	                return None
249	            time.sleep(0.5)
250	
251	
252	def commit_label():
253	    head = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "--short", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT,
254	                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip() or "none"
255	    dirty = subprocess.run(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], cwd=ROOT,
256	                           capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
257	    return head + ("-dirty" if dirty else "")

260	def gate(force, wait):
261	    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGHUP):  # through run_step's finally: kill the group
262	        signal.signal(sig, lambda n, _f: sys.exit(128 + n))
263	    started = time.monotonic()
264	    lock = take_lock(wait)
265	    if lock is None:
266	        print("gate: BLOCKED (build/gate/lock)", flush=True)
267	        return 3
268	    state_path = GATE / "state.json"
269	    try:
270	        state = json.loads(state_path.read_text())
271	    except (OSError, ValueError):
272	        state = {}
273	    commit, unstamped = commit_label(), []
274	    tools, digests = fingerprint(), tree_digests()
275	    with open(GATE / "times.tsv", "a") as times:
276	        for step in STEPS:
277	            begun = time.monotonic()
278	            before = step_hash(step, digests, tools)
279	            if not force and state.get(step) == before:
280	                result = "skip"
281	                print(f"gate: {step} skip {time.monotonic() - begun:.0f}s", flush=True)
282	            else:
283	                with open(GATE / f"{step}.log", "w") as log:
284	                    ok, why = run_step(step, log)
285	                tools, digests = fingerprint(), tree_digests()
286	                after = step_hash(step, digests, tools)
287	                result = "pass" if ok else "FAIL"
288	                print(f"gate: {step} {result} {time.monotonic() - begun:.0f}s", flush=True)
289	                for line in why[:5]:
290	                    print(f"    {line.strip()[:300]}", flush=True)
291	                if ok and record(state, step, before, after):
292	                    tmp = state_path.with_suffix(f".tmp-{os.getpid()}")
293	                    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=1, sort_keys=True))
294	                    os.replace(tmp, state_path)
295	                elif ok:
296	                    unstamped.append(step)
297	                    result = "pass-unstamped"
298	                    print(f"gate: {step} pass, not stamped: its inputs changed while it ran",
299	                          flush=True)
300	            utc = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
301	            times.write(f"{utc}\t{commit}\t{step}\t{time.monotonic() - begun:.1f}\t{result}\n")
302	            times.flush()
303	            if result == "FAIL":
304	                print(f"gate: FAIL {step} {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s", flush=True)
305	                return 1
306	    tail = f" (not stamped: {', '.join(unstamped)})" if unstamped else ""
307	    print(f"gate: PASS {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s{tail}", flush=True)
308	    return 0

311	def selftest(mutant=None):
312	    global MUTANT
313	    MUTANT, results = mutant, []
314	
315	    def row(name, ok, detail):
316	        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
317	        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)
318	
319	    # One file of each input class, and the steps a substituted digest must move.
320	    every = set(STEPS)
321	    classes = [
322	        ("M1", "app/Sources/Clip.swift", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
323	        ("M1", "app/Bridging/x.h", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
324	        ("M1", "core/include/framejob_core.h", every),
325	        ("M1", "agent/src/agent.ts", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
326	        ("M8", "tools/codecs/build_codecs.py", {"names", "typecheck", "test", "app"}),
327	        ("M2", "core/src/lib.rs", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
328	        ("M2", "graphic/src/lib.rs", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
329	        ("M2", "mcp-proxy/Cargo.toml", {"names", "fmt", "lint", "test", "app"}),
330	        ("M3", "project.yml", {"names", "test", "app"}),
331	        ("M3", "VERSION", {"names", "test", "app"}),
332	        ("M3", "app/Resources/Shaders/Compositor.metal", {"names", "test", "app"}),
333	        ("M3", "docs/graphics-api.md", {"names", "test", "app"}),
334	        ("M3", "docs/graphics-api.d.ts", {"names", "test", "app"}),
335	        ("M3", "tools/proof/dist_check.py", {"names", "test", "app"}),
336	        ("M3", "tools/proof/mcp.py", {"names", "test"}),
337	        ("M3", "designs/spec/x.md", {"names", "test"}),
338	        ("M3", "docs/manual-checks.md", {"names", "test"}),
339	        ("M4", "archive/x.md", set()),
340	        ("M4", "archive/x.py", set()),
341	        ("M4", "README.md", {"names"}),
342	        ("M5", "core/CLAUDE.md", {"names"}),
343	        ("M5", "app/CLAUDE.md", {"names"}),
344	        ("M6", "designs/adr/x.md", {"names"}),
345	        ("M7", HERE, every),
346	        ("M7", "Makefile", every),
347	    ]
348	    base = {path: "0" * 64 for _, path, _ in classes}
349	    hashes = {step: step_hash(step, base, "tools") for step in STEPS}
350	    again = {step: step_hash(step, dict(base), "tools") for step in STEPS}
351	    state = {}
352	    stamped = all(record(state, step, hashes[step], again[step]) for step in STEPS)
353	    row("H0", hashes == again and stamped and state == hashes,
354	        "CONTROL: identical digests give identical hashes, and every step is stamped")
355	    for name, path, expected in classes:
356	        changed = dict(base, **{path: "1" * 64})
357	        moved = {step for step in STEPS if step_hash(step, changed, "tools") != hashes[step]}
358	        row(name, moved == expected, f"{path} moves {sorted(moved)}, expected {sorted(expected)}")
359	    moved = {step for step in STEPS if step_hash(step, base, "tools 2") != hashes[step]}
360	    row("H2", moved == every, f"a substituted tool string moves {sorted(moved)}")
361	    state = {"test": "old"}
362	    stamped = record(state, "test", hashes["test"], hashes["app"])
363	    row("H3", not stamped and state == {"test": "old"}, "unequal hashes record no pass")
364	    row("H4", all(step_hash(step, dict(base, **{".secrets/x": "2"}), "tools") == hashes[step]
365	                  for step in STEPS),
366	        "CONTROL: a .secrets/ path is in no step's inputs")
367	
368	    def log(pairs, extra=""):
369	        lines = []
370	        for index, (name, message) in enumerate(pairs):
371	            lines += [f"app/Sources/{name}:{100 + index}:9: warning: {message}",
372	                      f"    |    `- warning: {message}"]
373	        return "\n".join(lines) + extra + "\n$ tsc --noEmit\n"
374	
375	    row("W0", typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE), 0) is None,
376	        "CONTROL: the four baseline warnings, at any line, each with its caret line, pass")
377	    fifth = TYPECHECK_BASELINE + (("Clip.swift", "'x' was deprecated"),)
378	    why = typecheck_verdict(log(fifth), 0)
379	    row("W1", why is not None and any("Clip.swift" in line for line in why),
380	        f"a fifth warning fails, named: {why}")
381	    moved_file = (("Clip.swift", TYPECHECK_BASELINE[0][1]),) + TYPECHECK_BASELINE[1:]
382	    why = typecheck_verdict(log(moved_file), 0)
383	    row("W2", why is not None, f"a baseline warning in another file fails: {why}")
384	    why = typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE[1:]), 0)
385	    row("W3", why is not None, f"a baseline warning gone fails: {why}")
386	    why = typecheck_verdict(log(TYPECHECK_BASELINE, "\napp/Sources/A.swift:1:1: error: nope"), 1)
387	    row("W4", why is not None and "error: nope" in why[0], f"an error fails, first: {why}")
388	
389	    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
390	    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
391	    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
392	    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
393	          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
394	    return 0 if ok else 1
395

397	def main(argv=None):
398	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="make gate (B88 phase 4)")
399	    parser.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="run every step")
400	    parser.add_argument("--wait", type=float, default=120.0,
401	                        help="seconds to wait for another gate's lock (default 120)")
402	    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true")
403	    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
404	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
405	    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
406	        return selftest(args.mutant)
407	    return gate(args.force, args.wait)

410	if __name__ == "__main__":
411	    sys.exit(main())

1	# Builds, signs (Developer ID), notarizes and publishes FrameJob.dmg as a
2	# GitHub Release on every push to the `publish` branch (spec §11 PUB-1..PUB-9).
3	# Rasterize's workflow, renamed, with three differences: the archive is the
4	# Distribution configuration (no dev tools, spec §11 V-1), the Metal toolchain
5	# is checked for, and the exported app is checked by
6	# tools/proof/published_check.py before it is packed. Beside the DMG goes a
7	# one-item appcast.xml, the stapled DMG's EdDSA signature in it, which every
8	# installed copy's Sparkle reads from the latest release (spec §11
9	# PUB-6..PUB-9, tools/proof/appcast.py).
10	#
11	# Version: "<VERSION file>.<run number>", build number = run number. The run
12	# counter belongs to this file — renaming or recreating it restarts numbering,
13	# so leave the name alone. A re-run keeps its run number and replaces the
14	# release's DMG and appcast rather than failing, and leaves Latest alone; a
15	# run that creates an older release than the current Latest creates it with
16	# --latest=false, so Latest is always the highest run number (PUB-6).
17	#
18	# Secrets (in the `publish` environment, restricted to the `publish` branch):
19	#   DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64, DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD, KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD,
20	#   APPLE_TEAM_ID, ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64,
21	#   SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY (the owner's EdDSA private key, `generate_keys -x`
22	#   output, spec §11 PUB-8; the first step fails without it)
23	name: Publish
24	
25	on:
26	  push:
27	    branches: [publish]
28	
29	concurrency:
30	  group: publish
31	  cancel-in-progress: false
32	
33	permissions:
34	  contents: write
35	
36	jobs:
37	  publish:
38	    runs-on: macos-26
39	    environment: publish
40	    timeout-minutes: 60
41	    steps:
42	      # Nothing ships unsigned (spec §11 PUB-8): without the update key the run
43	      # stops here, before anything is built or signed.
44	      - name: Check the update key
45	        env:
46	          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
47	        run: |
48	          if ! [ -n "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
49	            echo "::error::The publish environment has no SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY secret (spec §11 PUB-8)"
50	            exit 1
51	          fi
52	
53	      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
54	
55	      - name: Toolchain
56	        run: |
57	          xcodebuild -version
58	          rustup toolchain install stable --profile minimal
59	          rustup default stable
60	          rustc --version
61	          brew install xcodegen
62	          # The bundled encoders (spec §11 CX-5): Xcode's "Build Codecs" step
63	          # fetches the pinned tarballs and builds them with cmake, which a
64	          # runner image may or may not carry; the system perl is enough.
65	          command -v cmake >/dev/null || brew install cmake
66	          cmake --version
67	          # Compositor.metal is compiled by the build, and Xcode 26 ships the
68	          # Metal toolchain as a separate component an image may not carry.
69	          if ! xcrun metal --version > /dev/null 2>&1; then
70	            xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain
71	          fi
72	          xcrun metal --version
73	
74	      # Builds the assistant's agent helper (agent/) in the Xcode post-build step.
75	      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
76	
77	      # core/ builds graphic/ as a path dependency; mcp-proxy/ is framejob-mcp.
78	      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
79	        with:
80	          workspaces: |
81	            core
82	            mcp-proxy
83	
84	      - name: Compute paths and version
85	        run: |
86	          # The runner context isn't available in job-level env, so the paths
87	          # under RUNNER_TEMP are exported here for the later steps.
88	          {
89	            echo "KEYCHAIN=$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
90	            echo "ARCHIVE=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.xcarchive"
91	            echo "EXPORT=$RUNNER_TEMP/export"
92	            echo "DMG=$RUNNER_TEMP/FrameJob.dmg"
93	            echo "APPCAST=$RUNNER_TEMP/appcast.xml"
94	            echo "ED_KEY=$RUNNER_TEMP/sparkle_ed_key"
95	          } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
96	          BASE="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < VERSION)"
97	          # macOS versions are at most three integers; the run number is the third.
98	          if ! [[ "$BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
99	            echo "::error::VERSION must be MAJOR.MINOR, got '$BASE'"
100	            exit 1
101	          fi
102	          echo "VERSION=$BASE.$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
103	          echo "BUILD_NUMBER=$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
104	
105	      - name: Import signing certificate
106	        env:
107	          P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_BASE64 }}
108	          P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEVELOPER_ID_P12_PASSWORD }}
109	          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
110	        run: |
111	          P12="$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12"
112	          echo "$P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$P12"
113	          security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
114	          security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN"
115	          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN"
116	          security import "$P12" -P "$P12_PASSWORD" -A -t cert -f pkcs12 -k "$KEYCHAIN"
117	          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN" > /dev/null
118	          # Put the signing keychain in the search list so xcodebuild and codesign find it.
119	          # The existing entries are split on purpose; runner keychain paths have no spaces.
120	          # shellcheck disable=SC2046
121	          security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN" $(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"')
122	          rm "$P12"
123	          security find-identity -v -p codesigning "$KEYCHAIN"
124	
125	      # Distribution is the configuration that ships (spec §11 V-1): Release
126	      # without FRAMEJOB_DEV_TOOLS, and without the get-task-allow notarization
127	      # refuses. The two helpers are signed by their own build steps with the
128	      # identity given here, before Xcode signs the app around them.
129	      - name: Archive
130	        env:
131	          TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
132	        run: |
133	          make project
134	          xcodebuild archive \
135	            -project FrameJob.xcodeproj -scheme FrameJob -configuration Distribution \
136	            -destination 'generic/platform=macOS' \
137	            -derivedDataPath build \
138	            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
139	            CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
140	            CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Developer ID Application" \
141	            DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$TEAM_ID" \
142	            OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS=--timestamp \
143	            MARKETING_VERSION="$VERSION" \
144	            CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$BUILD_NUMBER"
145	
146	      # published_check.py holds what notarization does not look at: no dev
147	      # tools, each binary's exact entitlements after the export's re-sign, the
148	      # catalog snapshot, the two version numbers, and the updater: Sparkle's
149	      # framework and helpers signed with the app's team and the hardened
150	      # runtime, the feed and a 32-byte EdDSA public key (spec §11 PUB-6..PUB-8).
151	      - name: Export
152	        run: |
153	          xcodebuild -exportArchive \
154	            -archivePath "$ARCHIVE" \
155	            -exportOptionsPlist .github/ExportOptions.plist \
156	            -exportPath "$EXPORT"
157	          APP="$EXPORT/Frame Job.app"
158	          codesign --verify --deep --strict --verbose=2 "$APP"
159	          codesign -dvv "$APP" 2>&1 | grep -E '^(Authority|TeamIdentifier|Timestamp|Runtime)'
160	          python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$APP" \
161	            --version "$VERSION" --build "$BUILD_NUMBER"
162	
163	      - name: Build DMG
164	        run: |
165	          STAGE="$RUNNER_TEMP/dmg"
166	          mkdir -p "$STAGE"
167	          cp -R "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" "$STAGE/"
168	          ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
169	          # hdiutil's own estimate of the scratch volume from -srcfolder now
170	          # and then comes out short ("No space left on device" copying the
171	          # helper), so the size is the staged folder's plus a quarter and
172	          # 64 MB; UDZO compresses the free space away.
173	          SIZE_MB=$(( $(du -sm "$STAGE" | cut -f1) * 5 / 4 + 64 ))
174	          hdiutil create -volname "Frame Job" -srcfolder "$STAGE" -size "${SIZE_MB}m" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"
175	          codesign --sign "Developer ID Application" --timestamp --keychain "$KEYCHAIN" "$DMG"
176	
177	      - name: Notarize
178	        env:
179	          ASC_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_ID }}
180	          ASC_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.ASC_ISSUER_ID }}
181	          ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64 }}
182	        run: |
183	          KEY="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
184	          echo "$ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$KEY"
185	          AUTH=(--key "$KEY" --key-id "$ASC_KEY_ID" --issuer "$ASC_ISSUER_ID")
186	          OUT="$(xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG" "${AUTH[@]}" --wait --timeout 30m --output-format json)"
187	          echo "$OUT"
188	          ID="$(jq -r .id <<< "$OUT")"
189	          STATUS="$(jq -r .status <<< "$OUT")"
190	          if [ "$STATUS" != "Accepted" ]; then
191	            xcrun notarytool log "$ID" "${AUTH[@]}" || true
192	            echo "::error::Notarization finished with status '$STATUS'"
193	            exit 1
194	          fi
195	          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG"
196	          xcrun stapler validate "$DMG"
197	          spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$DMG"
198	
199	      # The EdDSA signature is made over the stapled DMG, the bytes the release
200	      # serves (spec §11 PUB-8). sign_update is the Sparkle package's own, from
201	      # the archive's package resolution; the key reaches it only as a 0600
202	      # file, removed straight after (and by the clean-up step on a failure).
203	      - name: Sign the update and write the appcast
204	        env:
205	          SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY }}
206	        run: |
207	          COUNT="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
208	          if [ "$COUNT" != 1 ]; then
209	            echo "::error::Expected one sign_update under build/SourcePackages/artifacts, found $COUNT"
210	            exit 1
211	          fi
212	          SIGN_UPDATE="$(find build/SourcePackages/artifacts -path '*/bin/sign_update' -type f)"
213	          umask 077; printf '%s' "$SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY" > "$ED_KEY"
214	          python3 tools/proof/appcast.py write \
215	            --app "$EXPORT/Frame Job.app" \
216	            --dmg "$DMG" \
217	            --sign-update "$SIGN_UPDATE" \
218	            --key-file "$ED_KEY" \
219	            --url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/download/v$VERSION/FrameJob.dmg" \
220	            --notes-url "https://github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tag/v$VERSION" \
221	            --out "$APPCAST"
222	          rm -f "$ED_KEY"
223	
224	      - name: Publish release
225	        env:
226	          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
227	        run: |
228	          TAG="v$VERSION"
229	          if gh release view "$TAG" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
230	            # A re-run: both assets replaced, Latest left alone (spec §11 PUB-6).
231	            gh release upload "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" --clobber
232	          else
233	            # The feed is releases/latest/download/appcast.xml, so Latest is
234	            # always the highest run number (spec §11 PUB-6): a release older
235	            # than the current Latest (an old run re-run) is not made Latest.
236	            LATEST="$(gh release view --json tagName -q .tagName 2>/dev/null || true)"
237	            MAKE_LATEST="--latest"
238	            if [ -n "$LATEST" ] && [ "${LATEST##*.}" -gt "$GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER" ] 2> /dev/null; then
239	              MAKE_LATEST="--latest=false"
240	            fi
241	            gh release create "$TAG" "$DMG" "$APPCAST" \
242	              --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
243	              --title "Frame Job $VERSION" \
244	              --generate-notes \
245	              "$MAKE_LATEST"
246	          fi
247	
248	      - name: Clean up signing material
249	        if: always()
250	        run: |
251	          security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN" 2> /dev/null || true
252	          rm -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/cert.p12" "$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8" "$ED_KEY"
