content.content:
CFBundleTypeRole: Editor
            NSDocumentClass: FrameJob.ProjectDocument
            LSHandlerRank: Alternate
    # The hardened-runtime entitlement the microphone needs (road map 3, R0's
    # second surprise: a bare swiftc probe never needs it, the signed app
    # does), and the camera's, added on that finding (spec §11 CAM-3: CR0
    # measured only a bare binary under the terminal's grant). The file is
    # GENERATED by xcodegen from these properties, like app/Info.plist, and
    # git-ignored beside it.
    entitlements:
      path: app/FrameJob.entitlements
      properties:
        com.apple.security.device.audio-input: true
        com.apple.security.device.camera: true
    preBuildScripts:
      # The bundled encoders (road map "codec-export" C0, spec §11 CX-5):
      # tools/codecs/build_codecs.py fetches, checks and builds SVT-AV1 and
      # libvpx into build/codecs/, or reuses them by its stamp (a no-op costs
      # well under a second), so the step runs every build. The PATH is Build
      # Rust Core's without cargo; the script also finds cmake in
      # /opt/homebrew/bin or /usr/local/bin when Xcode's PATH lacks Homebrew,
      # and builds under its own scrubbed environment, so this step and a
      # shell's `make codecs` compute one key.
      - name: Build Codecs
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          python3 "$PROJECT_DIR/tools/codecs/build_codecs.py"
        outputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libSvtAv1Enc.a
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/build/codecs/lib/libvpx.a
      - name: Build Rust Core
        # cargo decides staleness, so the step runs every build (a no-op
        # costs 0.1 s).
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          # /usr/bin is ahead of Xcode's own PATH, so `cc` is the xcrun shim a
          # shell finds and not the toolchain's clang: with SDKROOT unset (below) that
          # clang has no SDK, and a COLD build of rquickjs-sys's C stops at
          # "'stdlib.h' file not found". `make app` never met it, because
          # `make rust` builds first; an archive on a fresh checkout does.
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/usr/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/core"
          # Xcode exports MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET and SDKROOT, a shell's
          # `make rust` neither, and rquickjs-sys's build script reruns when
          # MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET changes: with them set, the shell build
          # and this step rebuilt rquickjs-sys, graphic and core in turn, and
          # a tree copy's step (its `core` is a symlink) rewrote the tree's
          # core/target (#225). Unset, both builds are the same build.
          env -u MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET -u SDKROOT cargo build --release
        outputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/core/target/release/libframejob_core.a
    # The graphics reference (road map 10's G4a): `graphic_reference` reads
    # GraphicsAPI.md, and a package's graphics/ gets both as API.md and
    # API.d.ts. Copied under new names, so not a resources-phase entry.
    postBuildScripts:
      - name: Copy Graphics Reference
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/docs/graphics-api.md" "$dest/GraphicsAPI.md"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/docs/graphics-api.d.ts" "$dest/GraphicsAPI.d.ts"
        inputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.md
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/docs/graphics-api.d.ts
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.md
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicsAPI.d.ts
      # The graphic templates (road map 10's G5b): Insert ▸ Graphic lists the
      # six modules of graphic/tests/graphics/, copied as they are.
      - name: Copy Graphic Templates
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/GraphicTemplates"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR"/graphic/tests/graphics/*.js "$dest/"
        inputFiles:
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/bar-chart.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/callout.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/counter.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/kinetic-type.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/lower-third.js
          - $(PROJECT_DIR)/graphic/tests/graphics/title-card.js
        outputFiles:
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/bar-chart.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/callout.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/counter.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/kinetic-type.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/lower-third.js
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/title-card.js
      # The encoders' licence and patent texts (spec §11 CX-5 (4), #376):
      # build/codecs/licenses/<library>/ as Build Codecs installed them, into
      # Contents/Resources/Licenses/ (tools/proof/dist_check.py D40/D41).
      - name: Copy Codec Licences
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/Licenses"
          rm -rf "$dest"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp -R "$PROJECT_DIR"/build/codecs/licenses/* "$dest/"
      # The assistant's agent helper (agent/, spec §11 AI-1): compiled with
      # Bun, placed in Contents/Helpers and signed by agent/build.sh, before
      # Xcode signs the app around it — the app's own signature does not
      # cover a nested executable. Without bun it fails; it never skips.
      - name: Build Agent Helper
        # Bun rebuilds the helper in well under a second, so it runs every build.
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: /bin/sh "$PROJECT_DIR/agent/build.sh" helper
      # The stdio MCP server external clients start (road map 14's MC3, spec
      # §11 MC-3): mcp-proxy/ built by cargo, put in Contents/Helpers beside the
      # assistant's helper and signed as agent/build.sh signs that one (the
      # hardened runtime, no entitlements), before Xcode signs the app.
      - name: Build MCP Proxy
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy"
          cargo build --release
          HELPERS="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/Helpers"
          mkdir -p "$HELPERS"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy/target/release/framejob-mcp" "$HELPERS/"
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP=""
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          codesign --force --options runtime $TIMESTAMP \
            --sign "$IDENTITY" "$HELPERS/framejob-mcp"
      # The catalog snapshot framejob-mcp lists from while no Frame Job runs
      # (MC-4; MC1 q1): the just-linked executable, ad-hoc signed alone in place
      # because the linker leaves it unsigned and arm64 kills an unsigned exec,
      # run with -RCWriteCatalog (AgentCatalogSnapshot.swift), then the bundle
      # signed again as Xcode's CodeSign signs it. It fails on a non-zero exit
      # and on any `Frame Job: ` line, the parity check complaining.
      - name: Write Agent Catalog
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          out="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/agent-catalog.json"
          exe="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$EXECUTABLE_PATH"
          # The codesign below re-seals the bundle, writing the marker
          # tools/proof/proof_app.py reads as a complete build; any failure
          # from here on removes it, so a failed build is refused (B88).
          marker="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/_CodeSignature/CodeResources"
          trap 'rm -f "$marker"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
          codesign -s - -f "$exe"
          rc=0
          output=$("$exe" -RCWriteCatalog "$out" 2>&1) || rc=$?
          if [ -n "$output" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; fi
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer exited $rc"
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q 'Frame Job: '; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer's output holds the parity check's complaint"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Xcode's CodeSign task does not see this step change the bundle, so
          # a build where nothing else changed skips it and would ship the
          # ad-hoc signature above (no entitlements) over a catalog written
          # after it. Seal the bundle as that task does: its identity and its
          # processed entitlements (B88; a second no-op `make dist` failed D14).
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP="--timestamp=none"
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          RUNTIME=""
          if [ "$ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME" = YES ]; then RUNTIME="-o runtime"; fi
          codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" $RUNTIME $TIMESTAMP \
            --entitlements "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/$FULL_PRODUCT_NAME.xcent" \
            --generate-entitlement-der "$CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH"
          trap - EXIT
        inputFiles:
          # Ordering only (the step runs every build): the entitlements it
          # signs with, and the Info.plist its seal covers.
          - $(TARGET_TEMP_DIR)/$(FULL_PRODUCT_NAME).xcent
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(INFOPLIST_PATH)

schemes:
  FrameJob:
    build:
      targets:
        FrameJob: all
    run:
      config: Release
    # Product > Archive never ships the dev tools.
    archive:
      config: Distribution
# encoder-only into build/codecs/ (headers, archives, licence texts), reused
# by its stamp — like cargo, a no-op when nothing changed. Needs cmake
# (`brew install cmake`), the system perl, and the network for the first
# fetch. project.yml's "Build Codecs" step runs the same script.
codecs:
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py

# `assistant_lane_proof.py` is spec §11 AI-3's `make test`-reachable probe
# (the agent lane); `rust` first, because it links the staticlib.
# `prices_proof.py` is road map 13 P1's price function: the Python reader and
# the helper's `bun test` (agent/build.sh test) against one fixture file, no
# network. `budget_proof.py` is P3's proofs' ledger and monthly budgets (spec
# §11 P-6), over scratch ledgers only, no network. `inventory.py --check` checks the
# menu inventory's sites against app/Sources, each found by its token and
# enclosing function rather than its line, and its other citations by
# anchor; no app, no build. `spec_index_proof.py` (issue batch B70) checks the
# spec indexes' Lines cells against `wc -l` and a row for every spec file.
# `proof_defaults.py` (issue batch B83, #238) is the defaults removal recipe
# on a throwaway domain, its refusals over scratch folders, then the sweep of
# the proofs' own idle domains, and of the two probes this target ran, out of
# `~/Library/Preferences`; no app.
# `mcp-proxy` is road map 14's `framejob-mcp`, its tests black-box over the
# built binary's stdin and stdout. `name_residue.py` (spec §11 NM-8) fails
# on any line or path spelling the old name that its allow-list does not
# hold; its selftest runs first. `appcast.py --selftest` (spec §11 PUB-6, PUB-8)
# is the publish workflow's appcast writer over a stand-in `sign_update`: no
# network, no key. `build_codecs.py --selftest` (codec-export C0) is the
# encoder build's key, reuse and digest rules, no network and no cmake; `codecs`
# first, because swift_build.py's selftest links the archives.
test: rust codecs
	cd core && cargo test --release
	cd graphic && cargo test --release
	cd mcp-proxy && cargo test --release
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_lane_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_prompt_proof.py --probe
	python3 tools/proof/prices_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/budget_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.py --check
	python3 tools/proof/spec_index_proof.py
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/swift_build.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_app.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/gate.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/appcast.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_defaults.py --ran assistant_lane_probe --ran assistant_prompt_probe
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py

lint:
	cd core && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
	cd graphic && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
# signed with the hardened runtime and hold no entitlements, and its catalog
# snapshot (Contents/Resources/agent-catalog.json) must be at the bundle's
# version, Release's naming every dev tool and Distribution's none (road map
# 14 MC3, D15–D24); and the Release app must be signed with exactly Xcode's
# audio-input, camera and get-task-allow, and both apps must pass `codesign --verify
# --deep --strict` (issue batch B88, D25–D27); and the updater (spec §11
# PUB-6..PUB-9, D28–D35): Distribution's Sparkle.framework signed with the
# app's team and its helpers with the hardened runtime, its feed and a 32-byte
# EdDSA public key, Release's both empty, the updater's code
# (FRAMEJOB_UPDATER, compiled by this target alone) in Distribution's binary
# and not in Release's, and no Sparkle load command in Release's. Until the owner's public key lands, D31 and P20 fail
# by the owner's choice (PUB-8). The file-wide `unexport RC_ASSEMBLYAI_KEY`
# above covers this recipe too. `published_check.py` is the check the publish
# workflow runs over the app it is about to pack (spec §11 PUB-4), run here over
# the Distribution build so it cannot rot between two publishes; it runs even
# when `dist_check.py` fails, and the recipe exits non-zero if either failed.
dist: app
	xcodebuild -project $(APP).xcodeproj -scheme $(APP) -configuration Distribution \
		-derivedDataPath $(BUILD_DIR) build
	rc=0; python3 tools/proof/dist_check.py --release "$(APP_PATH)" --dist "$(DIST_PATH)" || rc=1; python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$(DIST_PATH)" || rc=1; exit $$rc

# The one Full verification command (issue batch B88, tools/proof/gate.py):
# typecheck (exactly its four baseline warnings), fmt --check, lint, test, then
# app with dist_check's D25/D26 over the Release app; serial, stopping at the
# first failure, skipping a step whose inputs and tools are byte-identical to
# its last pass. Its state is build/gate/. `GATE_ARGS=--force` runs every step.

          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH)/GraphicTemplates/title-card.js
      # The encoders' licence and patent texts (spec §11 CX-5 (4), #376):
      # build/codecs/licenses/<library>/ as Build Codecs installed them, into
      # Contents/Resources/Licenses/ (tools/proof/dist_check.py D40/D41).
      - name: Copy Codec Licences
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          dest="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/Licenses"
          rm -rf "$dest"
          mkdir -p "$dest"
          cp -R "$PROJECT_DIR"/build/codecs/licenses/* "$dest/"
      # The assistant's agent helper (agent/, spec §11 AI-1): compiled with
      # Bun, placed in Contents/Helpers and signed by agent/build.sh, before
      # Xcode signs the app around it — the app's own signature does not
      # cover a nested executable. Without bun it fails; it never skips.
      - name: Build Agent Helper
        # Bun rebuilds the helper in well under a second, so it runs every build.
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: /bin/sh "$PROJECT_DIR/agent/build.sh" helper
      # The stdio MCP server external clients start (road map 14's MC3, spec
      # §11 MC-3): mcp-proxy/ built by cargo, put in Contents/Helpers beside the
      # assistant's helper and signed as agent/build.sh signs that one (the
      # hardened runtime, no entitlements), before Xcode signs the app.
      - name: Build MCP Proxy
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
          cd "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy"
          cargo build --release
          HELPERS="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/Helpers"
          mkdir -p "$HELPERS"
          cp "$PROJECT_DIR/mcp-proxy/target/release/framejob-mcp" "$HELPERS/"
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP=""
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          codesign --force --options runtime $TIMESTAMP \
            --sign "$IDENTITY" "$HELPERS/framejob-mcp"
      # The catalog snapshot framejob-mcp lists from while no Frame Job runs
      # (MC-4; MC1 q1): the just-linked executable, ad-hoc signed alone in place
      # because the linker leaves it unsigned and arm64 kills an unsigned exec,
      # run with -RCWriteCatalog (AgentCatalogSnapshot.swift), then the bundle
      # signed again as Xcode's CodeSign signs it. It fails on a non-zero exit
      # and on any `Frame Job: ` line, the parity check complaining.
      - name: Write Agent Catalog
        basedOnDependencyAnalysis: false
        script: |
          set -e
          out="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$UNLOCALIZED_RESOURCES_FOLDER_PATH/agent-catalog.json"
          exe="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$EXECUTABLE_PATH"
          # The codesign below re-seals the bundle, writing the marker
          # tools/proof/proof_app.py reads as a complete build; any failure
          # from here on removes it, so a failed build is refused (B88).
          marker="$TARGET_BUILD_DIR/$CONTENTS_FOLDER_PATH/_CodeSignature/CodeResources"
          trap 'rm -f "$marker"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
          codesign -s - -f "$exe"
          rc=0
          output=$("$exe" -RCWriteCatalog "$out" 2>&1) || rc=$?
          if [ -n "$output" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$output"; fi
          if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer exited $rc"
            exit 1
          fi
          if printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -q 'Frame Job: '; then
            echo "error: the catalog writer's output holds the parity check's complaint"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Xcode's CodeSign task does not see this step change the bundle, so
          # a build where nothing else changed skips it and would ship the
          # ad-hoc signature above (no entitlements) over a catalog written
          # after it. Seal the bundle as that task does: its identity and its
          # processed entitlements (B88; a second no-op `make dist` failed D14).
          IDENTITY="${EXPANDED_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY:--}"
          TIMESTAMP="--timestamp=none"
          if [ "$IDENTITY" != "-" ]; then TIMESTAMP="--timestamp"; fi
          RUNTIME=""
          if [ "$ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME" = YES ]; then RUNTIME="-o runtime"; fi
          codesign --force --sign "$IDENTITY" $RUNTIME $TIMESTAMP \
            --entitlements "$TARGET_TEMP_DIR/$FULL_PRODUCT_NAME.xcent" \
            --generate-entitlement-der "$CODESIGNING_FOLDER_PATH"
          trap - EXIT
        inputFiles:
          # Ordering only (the step runs every build): the entitlements it
          # signs with, and the Info.plist its seal covers.
          - $(TARGET_TEMP_DIR)/$(FULL_PRODUCT_NAME).xcent
          - $(TARGET_BUILD_DIR)/$(INFOPLIST_PATH)

schemes:
  FrameJob:
    build:
      targets:
        FrameJob: all
    run:
      config: Release
    # Product > Archive never ships the dev tools.
    archive:
      config: Distribution
# encoder-only into build/codecs/ (headers, archives, licence texts), reused
# by its stamp — like cargo, a no-op when nothing changed. Needs cmake
# (`brew install cmake`), the system perl, and the network for the first
# fetch. project.yml's "Build Codecs" step runs the same script.
codecs:
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py

# `assistant_lane_proof.py` is spec §11 AI-3's `make test`-reachable probe
# (the agent lane); `rust` first, because it links the staticlib.
# `prices_proof.py` is road map 13 P1's price function: the Python reader and
# the helper's `bun test` (agent/build.sh test) against one fixture file, no
# network. `budget_proof.py` is P3's proofs' ledger and monthly budgets (spec
# §11 P-6), over scratch ledgers only, no network. `inventory.py --check` checks the
# menu inventory's sites against app/Sources, each found by its token and
# enclosing function rather than its line, and its other citations by
# anchor; no app, no build. `spec_index_proof.py` (issue batch B70) checks the
# spec indexes' Lines cells against `wc -l` and a row for every spec file.
# `proof_defaults.py` (issue batch B83, #238) is the defaults removal recipe
# on a throwaway domain, its refusals over scratch folders, then the sweep of
# the proofs' own idle domains, and of the two probes this target ran, out of
# `~/Library/Preferences`; no app.
# `mcp-proxy` is road map 14's `framejob-mcp`, its tests black-box over the
# built binary's stdin and stdout. `name_residue.py` (spec §11 NM-8) fails
# on any line or path spelling the old name that its allow-list does not
# hold; its selftest runs first. `appcast.py --selftest` (spec §11 PUB-6, PUB-8)
# is the publish workflow's appcast writer over a stand-in `sign_update`: no
# network, no key. `build_codecs.py --selftest` (codec-export C0) is the
# encoder build's key, reuse and digest rules, no network and no cmake; `codecs`
# first, because swift_build.py's selftest links the archives.
test: rust codecs
	cd core && cargo test --release
	cd graphic && cargo test --release
	cd mcp-proxy && cargo test --release
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_lane_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/assistant_prompt_proof.py --probe
	python3 tools/proof/prices_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/budget_proof.py
	python3 tools/proof/capture_spike/inventory.py --check
	python3 tools/proof/spec_index_proof.py
	python3 tools/codecs/build_codecs.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/swift_build.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_app.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/gate.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/appcast.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/proof_defaults.py --ran assistant_lane_probe --ran assistant_prompt_probe
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py --selftest
	python3 tools/proof/name_residue.py

lint:
	cd core && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
	cd graphic && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
# signed with the hardened runtime and hold no entitlements, and its catalog
# snapshot (Contents/Resources/agent-catalog.json) must be at the bundle's
# version, Release's naming every dev tool and Distribution's none (road map
# 14 MC3, D15–D24); and the Release app must be signed with exactly Xcode's
# audio-input, camera and get-task-allow, and both apps must pass `codesign --verify
# --deep --strict` (issue batch B88, D25–D27); and the updater (spec §11
# PUB-6..PUB-9, D28–D35): Distribution's Sparkle.framework signed with the
# app's team and its helpers with the hardened runtime, its feed and a 32-byte
# EdDSA public key, Release's both empty, the updater's code
# (FRAMEJOB_UPDATER, compiled by this target alone) in Distribution's binary
# and not in Release's, and no Sparkle load command in Release's. Until the owner's public key lands, D31 and P20 fail
# by the owner's choice (PUB-8). The file-wide `unexport RC_ASSEMBLYAI_KEY`
# above covers this recipe too. `published_check.py` is the check the publish
# workflow runs over the app it is about to pack (spec §11 PUB-4), run here over
# the Distribution build so it cannot rot between two publishes; it runs even
# when `dist_check.py` fails, and the recipe exits non-zero if either failed.
dist: app
	xcodebuild -project $(APP).xcodeproj -scheme $(APP) -configuration Distribution \
		-derivedDataPath $(BUILD_DIR) build
	rc=0; python3 tools/proof/dist_check.py --release "$(APP_PATH)" --dist "$(DIST_PATH)" || rc=1; python3 tools/proof/published_check.py --app "$(DIST_PATH)" || rc=1; exit $$rc

# The one Full verification command (issue batch B88, tools/proof/gate.py):
# typecheck (exactly its four baseline warnings), fmt --check, lint, test, then
# app with dist_check's D25/D26 over the Release app; serial, stopping at the
# first failure, skipping a step whose inputs and tools are byte-identical to
# its last pass. Its state is build/gate/. `GATE_ARGS=--force` runs every step.

targets:
  FrameJob:
    type: application
    platform: macOS
    sources:
      - path: app/Sources
      - path: app/Assets.xcassets
      - path: app/Resources/Fonts
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Models
        type: folder
        buildPhase: resources
      # A one-frame 16x16 black movie. A timeline of nothing but text, shapes
      # and images owns no composition track, and AVFoundation gives a
      # composition of empty edits a duration of ZERO — so nothing renders
      # offline. This is the minimum real content that gives such a project a
      # track to tick against; the compositor never samples it.
      - path: app/Resources/Blank.mp4
        buildPhase: resources
      # 10 s of ALAC digital silence, 48 kHz stereo (spec §11 #336). An audio
      # track whose every clip has no source is nothing but empty edits, which
      # an export cannot read; this fills it back to back with real silence.
      - path: app/Resources/Silence.caf
        buildPhase: resources
      - path: app/Resources/Shaders
        buildPhase: sources
    # Sparkle (spec §11 PUB-7): embedded in every configuration, loaded only
    # in Distribution.
    dependencies:

  without one, the canonical SPDX text of its declared licence under its declared authors, and
  the build fails naming the package when no canonical text is vendored. A licence file nested
  inside a package must be listed in the generator's `NESTED` (to include or to exclude), or the
  build fails naming it. Sparkle gets its own `LICENSE` from the resolved package. Bun's
  `LICENSE.md` is vendored at `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` (`tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt`): a
  different `bun --version` fails a Distribution build (`--strict-bun`) and is a note in the
  file in the others. The encoders' texts come from `build/codecs/licenses/` (CX-5 (4), which
  this amends with SVT-AV1's `vector.c-LICENSE`); the voice-activity model and each bundled font
  are listed too, the fonts with their OFL text. The file is byte-identical for identical inputs
  (no timestamp). It has no About-panel entry, so no §9 row and no guide line. `dist_check.py`'s
  D42/D43 hold the Release and Distribution bundles to a header for every shipped crate and npm
  package, each pin, Sparkle at `project.yml`'s version, Bun, the model and each bundled font,

  `xcodebuild archive` strips the symbol table D37 reads, and the bytes survive the strip. P23
  is D39 (every load command a system library or Sparkle's), P24 D41 (the pins' licence texts,
  byte-identical to the checkout's `build/codecs/licenses/`) and P25 D43. No P row reads `nm`.

     `Contents/Resources/Licenses/<library>/`, copied from the source tree; the
     acknowledgements (#376) list them.

  first fetch, and a clean build of about one to two minutes.

  Writing container bytes is not sample work, under #216-R's precedent (`deepening.md`): the
  writer decides timestamps, cluster and cue placement and CodecDelay, and touches compressed

# Vendored licence texts — provenance

`tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py` (spec §11 PUB-10) writes every build's
`Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`. Two texts it needs are not in any lockfile or
package, so they are vendored here. Both are `.txt`, never `.md`: `tools/proof/gate.py`
counts no `*.md` under `tools/licenses/` as an input of the `app` step.

| File | What | Source | SHA-256 | Fetched |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bun/LICENSE.txt` | Bun's `LICENSE.md`, verbatim (no trailing newline, as published) | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v1.3.6/LICENSE.md>, tag `bun-v1.3.6` | `4cf82fd717b2b34dfabf6087c35fcffd28386054f1791d2e6ecfdfcafe0131a8` | 2026-10-28 |
| `spdx/MIT.txt` | The SPDX MIT text with its `Copyright (c) <year> <copyright holders>` line and the blank line after it removed; the generator writes a package's declared authors above it | <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/license-list-data/f715b3660bb164c3d0b81cba9ce94e3c558c4048/text/MIT.txt>, `spdx/license-list-data` commit `f715b3660bb164c3d0b81cba9ce94e3c558c4048` (the upstream file's SHA-256 `b05785f9f18e6716bab63424b11454513b9943a222595b70411009202fc592b5`) | `9645fb6e878aebd5e959be648a71973a108d4aa0d18eee478d0579066ad99958` | 2026-10-28 |

`spdx/<id>.txt` is the canonical text of one SPDX id, used for a package that ships no
licence file of its own. Only MIT is needed today (`rquickjs-core`, `rquickjs-sys`,
`standardwebhooks`); a package declaring an id with no file here fails the build, naming
the package and the id, and the fix is to vendor that id's text the same way.

## Re-vendoring Bun's licence

`BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` in `acknowledgements.py` is the Bun this text came from. The publish
workflow installs exactly that Bun (`oven-sh/setup-bun`'s `bun-version`, read with
`acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version`, spec §11 PUB-12), and a Distribution build whose
`bun --version` differs fails (`--strict-bun`); Debug and Release write a note instead. After
upgrading Bun:

```sh
V="$(bun --version)"
curl -fsSL -o tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt \
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v$V/LICENSE.md"
shasum -a 256 tools/licenses/bun/LICENSE.txt
```

then set `BUN_LICENSE_VERSION` to `$V`, and update the row above (tag, SHA-256, date).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10): `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`,
every third-party notice the bundle owes, written each build by project.yml's "Write
Acknowledgements" step.

    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --out PATH [--strict-bun] [--sparkle-license PATH]
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked

Crates: `cargo metadata --locked --offline --filter-platform TARGET` in each CARGO_ROOTS
folder, every package reachable from the root over a non-dev edge (normal and build, proc
macros included), FIRST_PARTY left out. npm: `agent/bun.lock`, the workspace's
`dependencies` through each package's own (never `devDependencies`, never an optional
peer), each version confirmed against `agent/node_modules/<name>/package.json`. Each
package gets its root licence files (a name starting with a LICENCE_PREFIXES entry, any
case); without one, the canonical text `tools/licenses/spdx/<id>.txt` under its declared
authors, and the build fails naming the package and the id when that text is not
vendored. A licence file nested in a package must be in NESTED (True includes it, False
leaves it out) or the build fails naming it; the scan skips `target/`, `node_modules/` and
any folder holding its own `Cargo.toml` or `package.json`. Then Bun (its `LICENSE.md`,
vendored at BUN_LICENSE_VERSION: another `bun --version` fails under `--strict-bun`, the
Distribution build, and is a note otherwise), Sparkle (the resolved package's own
`LICENSE` and version), the encoders (`build/codecs/licenses/`, build_codecs.PINS), the
voice-activity model and each bundled font with its OFL text.

The file is byte-identical for identical inputs (no timestamp) and written atomically.
`tools/proof/dist_check.py` D42/D43 check it with readers of their own. A `--mutant` runs
the selftest alone and must fail exactly its rows: `dev-edges` (dev edges walked) G1,
`nested-unchecked` (an unlisted nested licence skipped) L3, `bun-unchecked` (a Bun
mismatch passed under `--strict-bun`) B1. Stdlib only, Python 3.9 (`/usr/bin/python3`).
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NamedTuple, Optional

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = ROOT / "tools" / "licenses"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools" / "codecs"))
import build_codecs  # noqa: E402  (PINS: the encoders, in order)

FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp")
CARGO_ROOTS = ("core", "mcp-proxy")
TARGET = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
BUN_LICENSE_VERSION = "1.3.6"
LICENCE_PREFIXES = ("LICENSE", "LICENCE", "COPYING", "NOTICE", "UNLICENSE")
NESTED = {("rquickjs-sys", "quickjs/LICENSE"): True,
          ("rquickjs-sys", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md"): False,
          ("fontdb", "tests/fonts/LICENSE.txt"): False,
          ("@anthropic-ai/sdk", "src/internal/qs/LICENSE.md"): True}
PATCHED = {"tiny-skia": "spec §11 PR-13"}
LIBRARY_LICENCES = {"svt-av1": "BSD-3-Clause-Clear (parts BSD-2-Clause), with the Alliance "
                               "for Open Media Patent License 1.0",
                    "libvpx": "BSD-3-Clause, with the WebM Project's patent grant"}
SPARKLE_LICENSE = Path("SourcePackages/artifacts/sparkle/Sparkle/LICENSE")
SKIPPED = ("target", "node_modules")
EXPECTED = {"dev-edges": {"G1"}, "nested-unchecked": {"L3"}, "bun-unchecked": {"B1"}}
MUTANT = None
PREAMBLE = ("Frame Job is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It includes the "
            "third-party software below, each under the licence its entry names; each "
            "entry's full licence text follows it, or, where the same text has already "
            "appeared, a pointer to it.")


class Entry(NamedTuple):
    kind: str
    name: str
    version: str
    licence: str
    source: str
    texts: tuple  # ((label, text), ...)


class Failed(RuntimeError):
    pass


def read(path):
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def cargo_packages(metadata):
    """Package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges, FIRST_PARTY removed."""
    packages = {p["id"]: p for p in metadata["packages"]}
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]}
    seen, stack = set(), [metadata["resolve"]["root"]]
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        if current in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(current)
        for dep in nodes[current].get("deps", []):
            kinds = [k.get("kind") for k in dep.get("dep_kinds", [])]
            if MUTANT == "dev-edges" or any(kind != "dev" for kind in kinds):
                stack.append(dep["pkg"])
    return [packages[i] for i in sorted(seen) if packages[i]["name"] not in FIRST_PARTY]


def npm_packages(lock_text):
    """[(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's
    "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers."""
    lock = json.loads(re.sub(r",(\s*[}\]])", r"\1", lock_text))
    entries, found = lock.get("packages", {}), {}
    stack = [("", name) for name in sorted(lock["workspaces"][""].get("dependencies", {}))]
    while stack:
        parent, name = stack.pop()
        key = f"{parent}/{name}" if parent and f"{parent}/{name}" in entries else name
        if key not in entries:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {name} is not in agent/bun.lock's packages")
        entry = entries[key]
        version = entry[0].rsplit("@", 1)[1]
        if key in found:
            continue
        found[key] = (name, version)
        meta = entry[2] if len(entry) > 2 and isinstance(entry[2], dict) else {}
        stack += [(key, dep) for dep in sorted(meta.get("dependencies", {}))]
    return sorted(set(found.values()))


def _is_licence(name):
    return name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)


def _spdx_ids(licence):
    """The ids the canonical texts must cover: all of them for an AND, else the first of the
    alternatives with a vendored text (or every alternative, when none has one)."""
    ids = [t for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+", licence) if t not in ("AND", "OR", "WITH")]
    if " AND " in licence or "(" in licence:
        return ids
    held = [i for i in ids if (HERE / "spdx" / f"{i}.txt").is_file()]
    return held[:1] or ids


def licence_texts(directory, owner, licence, authors):
    """((label, text), ...): the root licence files, then the nested ones NESTED includes;
    without root files, the canonical SPDX texts under the authors."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    texts = [(p.name, read(p)) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir())
             if p.is_file() and _is_licence(p.name)]
    if not texts:
        if not licence:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and declares no licence")
        holders = ", ".join(authors) if authors else f"the {owner} authors"
        for spdx in _spdx_ids(licence):
            canonical = HERE / "spdx" / f"{spdx}.txt"
            if not canonical.is_file():
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and there is no "
                             f"canonical text for {spdx} (tools/licenses/spdx/{spdx}.txt)")
            texts.append((f"{spdx} (the SPDX text; {owner} ships no licence file)",
                          f"Copyright (c) {holders}\n\n{read(canonical)}"))
    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
        here = Path(folder)
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in SKIPPED
                         and not (here / d / "Cargo.toml").exists()
                         and not (here / d / "package.json").exists())
        if here == directory:
            continue
        for name in sorted(files):
            if not _is_licence(name):
                continue
            relative = (here / name).relative_to(directory).as_posix()
            listed = NESTED.get((owner, relative))
            if listed is None and MUTANT != "nested-unchecked":
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner}'s nested licence file {relative} is "
                             "not in NESTED (tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py): include or "
                             "exclude it")
            if listed:
                texts.append((relative, read(here / name)))
    return tuple(texts)


def font_revision(path):
    """The `head` table's fontRevision (16.16 fixed), to three decimals."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if len(data) < 12:
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} is not an sfnt font")
    count = struct.unpack(">H", data[4:6])[0]
    for index in range(count):
        tag, _, offset, _ = struct.unpack(">4sIII", data[12 + 16 * index:28 + 16 * index])
        if tag == b"head":
            return f"{struct.unpack('>i', data[offset + 4:offset + 8])[0] / 65536:.3f}"
    raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} has no head table")


def bun_check(found, strict):
    """None when `found` is BUN_LICENSE_VERSION; else Failed under `strict`, or the note."""
    if found == BUN_LICENSE_VERSION:
        return None
    message = (f"bun --version is {found or '(bun not found)'}, but the vendored licence is "
               f"Bun {BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}'s; re-vendor it (tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md)")
    if strict and MUTANT != "bun-unchecked":
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {message}")
    return message


def _bun_version():
    bun = shutil.which("bun")
    if bun is None:
        return None
    done = subprocess.run([bun, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return done.stdout.strip() if done.returncode == 0 else None


def _crates(root):
    found = {}
    for folder in CARGO_ROOTS:
        argv = ["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1", "--locked", "--offline",
                "--filter-platform", TARGET]
        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root / folder), capture_output=True, text=True,
                              timeout=300)
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {' '.join(argv)} in {folder}/ exited "
                         f"{done.returncode}: {done.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
        for package in cargo_packages(json.loads(done.stdout)):
            found[package["id"]] = package
    entries = []
    for p in sorted(found.values(), key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"])):
        directory = Path(p["manifest_path"]).parent
        if p.get("source") is None:
            relative = os.path.relpath(directory, root)
            note = f" (patched, {PATCHED[p['name']]})" if p["name"] in PATCHED else ""
            source = f"vendored at {relative}{note}"
        elif p["source"].startswith("registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"):
            source = "crates.io"
        else:
            source = p["source"]
        licence = p.get("license") or ""
        texts = licence_texts(directory, p["name"], licence, p.get("authors") or [])
        entries.append(Entry("crate", p["name"], p["version"], licence or "(none declared)",
                             source, texts))
    return entries


def _npm(root):
    agent = root / "agent"
    entries = []
    for name, version in npm_packages(read(agent / "bun.lock")):
        directory = agent / "node_modules" / name
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(read(directory / "package.json"))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/node_modules/{name}/package.json: {error}")
        if manifest.get("version") != version:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/bun.lock pins {name} {version}, but "
                         f"node_modules holds {manifest.get('version')} (run bun install)")
        licence = manifest.get("license") or ""
        if isinstance(licence, dict):
            licence = licence.get("type", "")
        author = manifest.get("author")
        if isinstance(author, dict):
            author = author.get("name")
        texts = licence_texts(directory, name, licence, [author] if author else [])
        entries.append(Entry("npm", name, version, licence or "(none declared)", "npm", texts))
    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.name)


def _sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license):
    if sparkle_license is None:
        tried = []
        starts = [Path(build_dir)] if build_dir else []
        for start in starts:
            tried += [folder / SPARKLE_LICENSE for folder in [start, *start.parents]]
        tried.append(root / "build" / SPARKLE_LICENSE)
        found = [path for path in tried if path.is_file()]
        if not found:
            raise Failed("acknowledgements: Sparkle's LICENSE is in none of "
                         + ", ".join(map(str, tried)))
        sparkle_license = found[0]
    state_path = Path(sparkle_license).parents[3] / "workspace-state.json"
    try:
        state = json.loads(read(state_path))
        version = [d["state"]["checkoutState"]["version"]
                   for d in state["object"]["dependencies"]
                   if d["packageRef"]["identity"] == "sparkle"][0]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: no resolved sparkle version in {state_path}: {error!r}")
    return Entry("framework", "sparkle", version, "MIT (with the notices its LICENSE lists)",
                 "https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle",
                 (("LICENSE", read(sparkle_license)),))


def collect(root, build_dir, strict_bun, sparkle_license):
    root = Path(root)
    entries = _crates(root) + _npm(root)
    note = bun_check(_bun_version(), strict_bun)
    if note:
        print(f"warning: {note}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    bun_texts = ((("note", note + "\n"),) if note else ()) + (
        ("LICENSE.md", read(HERE / "bun" / "LICENSE.txt")),)
    entries.append(Entry("runtime", "bun", BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
                         "MIT; it embeds JavaScriptCore and WebKit (LGPL-2) and the libraries "
                         "its notice lists", f"https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/bun-v"
                         f"{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}", bun_texts))
    entries.append(_sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license))
    for pin in build_codecs.PINS:
        texts = []
        for _, installed in pin.licenses:
            path = root / "build" / "codecs" / "licenses" / pin.name / installed
            if not path.is_file():
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} is missing (make codecs)")
            texts.append((installed, read(path)))
        entries.append(Entry("library", pin.name, pin.version, LIBRARY_LICENCES[pin.name],
                             pin.url, tuple(texts)))
    models = root / "app" / "Resources" / "Models"
    tag = re.search(r"tag `v([^`]+)`", read(models / "PROVENANCE.md"))
    if tag is None:
        raise Failed("acknowledgements: no tag `vX` in app/Resources/Models/PROVENANCE.md")
    entries.append(Entry("model", "silero-vad", tag.group(1), "MIT",
                         "https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad",
                         (("LICENSE", read(models / "LICENSE")),)))
    fonts = root / "app" / "Resources" / "Fonts"
    for font in sorted(fonts.glob("*.ttf"), key=lambda p: p.stem):
        ofl = fonts / f"OFL-{font.stem.split('-')[0]}.txt"
        if not ofl.is_file():
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {font.name} has no {ofl.name} beside it")
        entries.append(Entry("font", font.stem, font_revision(font), "OFL-1.1",
                             "vendored at app/Resources/Fonts", ((ofl.name, read(ofl)),)))
    return entries


def render(entries):
    out = ["Frame Job — third-party software notices",
           "Generated at build time by tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py; do not edit.",
           PREAMBLE, ""]
    first = {}
    for e in entries:
        out += [f"== {e.kind} {e.name} {e.version} ==", f"Licence: {e.licence}",
                f"Source: {e.source}"]
        for label, text in e.texts:
            out.append(f"--- {label} ---")
            if text in first:
                out.append(f"(identical to {first[text]}, above)")
            else:
                first[text] = f"{e.kind} {e.name} {e.version}'s {label}"
                out.append(text.rstrip("\n"))
        out.append("")
    return "\n".join(out)


def write(path, text):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".acknowledgements-", dir=str(path.parent))
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        out.write(text)
    os.chmod(temporary, 0o644)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


# ---- the selftest: no cargo, no network, scratch only ---------------------------------


def selftest(mutant=None):
    global MUTANT
    MUTANT, results = mutant, []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    def failure(call):
        try:
            call()
            return None
        except Failed as error:
            return str(error)

    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="acknowledgements-selftest-"))
    try:
        entries = [Entry("crate", "a", "1.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("crate", "b", "2.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("font", "F-Bold", "1.500", "OFL-1.1", "x", (("OFL-F.txt", "ofl\n"),))]
        one, two = render(entries), render(list(entries))
        row("D0", one == two and one.encode() == two.encode(),
            f"CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical ({len(one)} characters)")
        row("T1", "(identical to crate a 1.0's LICENSE, above)" in one
            and one.count("text a") == 1, "a repeated text becomes the 'identical to' line")

        def node(i, *deps):
            return {"id": i, "deps": [{"pkg": d, "dep_kinds": [{"kind": k}]} for d, k in deps]}
        metadata = {"packages": [{"id": i, "name": i, "version": "1"} for i in
                                 ("framejob-core", "graphic", "lib", "devonly", "buildonly",
                                  "devdeep")],
                    "resolve": {"root": "framejob-core", "nodes": [
                        node("framejob-core", ("graphic", None), ("devonly", "dev"),
                             ("buildonly", "build")),
                        node("graphic", ("lib", None)), node("lib"),
                        node("devonly", ("devdeep", None)), node("buildonly"),
                        node("devdeep")]}}
        names = {p["name"] for p in cargo_packages(metadata)}
        row("G1", "devonly" not in names and "devdeep" not in names
            and not names & set(FIRST_PARTY) and "lib" in names,
            f"dev edges and first-party are excluded: {sorted(names)}")
        row("G2", "buildonly" in names, f"build edges are included: {sorted(names)}")

        lock = """{
  "lockfileVersion": 1,
  "workspaces": { "": { "name": "x", "dependencies": { "a": "^1", },
      "devDependencies": { "dev": "^1", }, }, },
  "packages": {
    "a": ["a@1.2.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2", }, "peerDependencies": { "p": "^1" },
          "optionalPeers": ["p"], }, "sha512-x"],
    "b": ["b@2.0.1", "", {}, "sha512-y"],
    "dev": ["dev@1.0.0", "", {}, "sha512-z"],
    "p": ["p@1.0.0", "", {}, "sha512-w"],
  }
}"""
        got = npm_packages(lock)
        row("N1", got == [("a", "1.2.0"), ("b", "2.0.1")],
            f"a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers: {got}")

        bare = scratch / "bare"
        bare.mkdir()
        texts = licence_texts(bare, "bare", "MIT", ["Ann <ann@example.com>"])
        row("L1", len(texts) == 1 and texts[0][1].startswith("Copyright (c) Ann <ann@example")
            and "Permission is hereby granted" in texts[0][1],
            f"no licence file gives the SPDX text under the authors: {texts[0][0] if texts else None}")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(bare, "bare", "Foo-1.0", []))
        row("L2", why is not None and "bare" in why and "Foo-1.0" in why,
            f"no canonical text fails naming the package and id: {why}")
        nested = scratch / "nested"
        (nested / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
        (nested / "LICENSE").write_text("root\n")
        (nested / "sub" / "COPYING").write_text("nested\n")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(nested, "nested", "MIT", []))
        row("L3", why is not None and "sub/COPYING" in why,
            f"an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it: {why}")
        listed = scratch / "rquickjs-sys"
        for folder in ("quickjs", "vendor/wasi-libc", "crate"):
            (listed / folder).mkdir(parents=True)
        (listed / "quickjs" / "LICENSE").write_text("quickjs\n")
        (listed / "vendor" / "wasi-libc" / "NOTICE.md").write_text("wasi\n")
        (listed / "crate" / "Cargo.toml").write_text("")
        (listed / "crate" / "LICENSE").write_text("own crate\n")
        texts = licence_texts(listed, "rquickjs-sys", "MIT", [])
        labels = [label for label, _ in texts]
        row("L4", "quickjs/LICENSE" in labels and "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md" not in labels
            and "crate/LICENSE" not in labels,
            f"a listed include is written, an exclude is not: {labels}")

        head = struct.pack(">IIiI", 0x00010000, 0x00018000, 0, 0x5F0F3CF5)
        font = struct.pack(">IHHHH", 0x00010000, 1, 16, 0, 0)
        font += struct.pack(">4sIII", b"head", 0, 28, len(head)) + head
        path = scratch / "font.ttf"
        path.write_bytes(font)
        got = font_revision(path)
        row("F1", got == "1.500", f"the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt: {got}")

        other = "0.0.1" if BUN_LICENSE_VERSION != "0.0.1" else "0.0.2"
        why = failure(lambda: bun_check(other, True))
        note = bun_check(other, False) if mutant != "bun-unchecked" else bun_check(other, False)
        row("B1", why is not None and other in why and note is not None
            and BUN_LICENSE_VERSION in note and bun_check(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION, True) is None,
            f"a Bun mismatch fails under --strict-bun ({why}) and is noted without it")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10)")
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="where to write Acknowledgements.txt")
    parser.add_argument("--strict-bun", action="store_true",
                        help="fail when bun --version is not BUN_LICENSE_VERSION (Distribution)")
    parser.add_argument("--sparkle-license", help="Sparkle's LICENSE, else found from $BUILD_DIR")
    parser.add_argument("--print-bun-version", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="D0 G1 G2 N1 L1–L4 T1 F1 B1")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
        return selftest(args.mutant)
    if args.print_bun_version:
        print(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION)
        return 0
    if not args.out:
        parser.error("--out is required")
    try:
        sparkle = Path(args.sparkle_license) if args.sparkle_license else None
        entries = collect(ROOT, os.environ.get("BUILD_DIR"), args.strict_bun, sparkle)
        write(args.out, render(entries))
    except (Failed, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    print(f"acknowledgements: {len(entries)} entries in {args.out}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10): `Contents/Resources/Acknowledgements.txt`,
every third-party notice the bundle owes, written each build by project.yml's "Write
Acknowledgements" step.

    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --out PATH [--strict-bun] [--sparkle-license PATH]
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --print-bun-version
    python3 tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py --selftest | --mutant dev-edges|nested-unchecked|bun-unchecked

Crates: `cargo metadata --locked --offline --filter-platform TARGET` in each CARGO_ROOTS
folder, every package reachable from the root over a non-dev edge (normal and build, proc
macros included), FIRST_PARTY left out. npm: `agent/bun.lock`, the workspace's
`dependencies` through each package's own (never `devDependencies`, never an optional
peer), each version confirmed against `agent/node_modules/<name>/package.json`. Each
package gets its root licence files (a name starting with a LICENCE_PREFIXES entry, any
case); without one, the canonical text `tools/licenses/spdx/<id>.txt` under its declared
authors, and the build fails naming the package and the id when that text is not
vendored. A licence file nested in a package must be in NESTED (True includes it, False
leaves it out) or the build fails naming it; the scan skips `target/`, `node_modules/` and
any folder holding its own `Cargo.toml` or `package.json`. Then Bun (its `LICENSE.md`,
vendored at BUN_LICENSE_VERSION: another `bun --version` fails under `--strict-bun`, the
Distribution build, and is a note otherwise), Sparkle (the resolved package's own
`LICENSE` and version), the encoders (`build/codecs/licenses/`, build_codecs.PINS), the
voice-activity model and each bundled font with its OFL text.

The file is byte-identical for identical inputs (no timestamp) and written atomically.
`tools/proof/dist_check.py` D42/D43 check it with readers of their own. A `--mutant` runs
the selftest alone and must fail exactly its rows: `dev-edges` (dev edges walked) G1,
`nested-unchecked` (an unlisted nested licence skipped) L3, `bun-unchecked` (a Bun
mismatch passed under `--strict-bun`) B1. Stdlib only, Python 3.9 (`/usr/bin/python3`).
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NamedTuple, Optional

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
HERE = ROOT / "tools" / "licenses"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools" / "codecs"))
import build_codecs  # noqa: E402  (PINS: the encoders, in order)

FIRST_PARTY = ("framejob-core", "graphic", "framejob-mcp")
CARGO_ROOTS = ("core", "mcp-proxy")
TARGET = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
BUN_LICENSE_VERSION = "1.3.6"
LICENCE_PREFIXES = ("LICENSE", "LICENCE", "COPYING", "NOTICE", "UNLICENSE")
NESTED = {("rquickjs-sys", "quickjs/LICENSE"): True,
          ("rquickjs-sys", "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md"): False,
          ("fontdb", "tests/fonts/LICENSE.txt"): False,
          ("@anthropic-ai/sdk", "src/internal/qs/LICENSE.md"): True}
PATCHED = {"tiny-skia": "spec §11 PR-13"}
LIBRARY_LICENCES = {"svt-av1": "BSD-3-Clause-Clear (parts BSD-2-Clause), with the Alliance "
                               "for Open Media Patent License 1.0",
                    "libvpx": "BSD-3-Clause, with the WebM Project's patent grant"}
SPARKLE_LICENSE = Path("SourcePackages/artifacts/sparkle/Sparkle/LICENSE")
SKIPPED = ("target", "node_modules")
EXPECTED = {"dev-edges": {"G1"}, "nested-unchecked": {"L3"}, "bun-unchecked": {"B1"}}
MUTANT = None
PREAMBLE = ("Frame Job is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It includes the "
            "third-party software below, each under the licence its entry names; each "
            "entry's full licence text follows it, or, where the same text has already "
            "appeared, a pointer to it.")


class Entry(NamedTuple):
    kind: str
    name: str
    version: str
    licence: str
    source: str
    texts: tuple  # ((label, text), ...)


class Failed(RuntimeError):
    pass


def read(path):
    return Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def cargo_packages(metadata):
    """Package dicts reachable from resolve.root over non-dev edges, FIRST_PARTY removed."""
    packages = {p["id"]: p for p in metadata["packages"]}
    nodes = {n["id"]: n for n in metadata["resolve"]["nodes"]}
    seen, stack = set(), [metadata["resolve"]["root"]]
    while stack:
        current = stack.pop()
        if current in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(current)
        for dep in nodes[current].get("deps", []):
            kinds = [k.get("kind") for k in dep.get("dep_kinds", [])]
            if MUTANT == "dev-edges" or any(kind != "dev" for kind in kinds):
                stack.append(dep["pkg"])
    return [packages[i] for i in sorted(seen) if packages[i]["name"] not in FIRST_PARTY]


def npm_packages(lock_text):
    """[(name, version)] from workspaces[""].dependencies through each package's
    "dependencies"; not devDependencies, not optionalPeers."""
    lock = json.loads(re.sub(r",(\s*[}\]])", r"\1", lock_text))
    entries, found = lock.get("packages", {}), {}
    stack = [("", name) for name in sorted(lock["workspaces"][""].get("dependencies", {}))]
    while stack:
        parent, name = stack.pop()
        key = f"{parent}/{name}" if parent and f"{parent}/{name}" in entries else name
        if key not in entries:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {name} is not in agent/bun.lock's packages")
        entry = entries[key]
        version = entry[0].rsplit("@", 1)[1]
        if key in found:
            continue
        found[key] = (name, version)
        meta = entry[2] if len(entry) > 2 and isinstance(entry[2], dict) else {}
        stack += [(key, dep) for dep in sorted(meta.get("dependencies", {}))]
    return sorted(set(found.values()))


def _is_licence(name):
    return name.upper().startswith(LICENCE_PREFIXES)


def _spdx_ids(licence):
    """The ids the canonical texts must cover: all of them for an AND, else the first of the
    alternatives with a vendored text (or every alternative, when none has one)."""
    ids = [t for t in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9.+-]+", licence) if t not in ("AND", "OR", "WITH")]
    if " AND " in licence or "(" in licence:
        return ids
    held = [i for i in ids if (HERE / "spdx" / f"{i}.txt").is_file()]
    return held[:1] or ids


def licence_texts(directory, owner, licence, authors):
    """((label, text), ...): the root licence files, then the nested ones NESTED includes;
    without root files, the canonical SPDX texts under the authors."""
    directory = Path(directory)
    texts = [(p.name, read(p)) for p in sorted(directory.iterdir())
             if p.is_file() and _is_licence(p.name)]
    if not texts:
        if not licence:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and declares no licence")
        holders = ", ".join(authors) if authors else f"the {owner} authors"
        for spdx in _spdx_ids(licence):
            canonical = HERE / "spdx" / f"{spdx}.txt"
            if not canonical.is_file():
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner} ships no licence file and there is no "
                             f"canonical text for {spdx} (tools/licenses/spdx/{spdx}.txt)")
            texts.append((f"{spdx} (the SPDX text; {owner} ships no licence file)",
                          f"Copyright (c) {holders}\n\n{read(canonical)}"))
    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(directory):
        here = Path(folder)
        dirs[:] = sorted(d for d in dirs if d not in SKIPPED
                         and not (here / d / "Cargo.toml").exists()
                         and not (here / d / "package.json").exists())
        if here == directory:
            continue
        for name in sorted(files):
            if not _is_licence(name):
                continue
            relative = (here / name).relative_to(directory).as_posix()
            listed = NESTED.get((owner, relative))
            if listed is None and MUTANT != "nested-unchecked":
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {owner}'s nested licence file {relative} is "
                             "not in NESTED (tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py): include or "
                             "exclude it")
            if listed:
                texts.append((relative, read(here / name)))
    return tuple(texts)


def font_revision(path):
    """The `head` table's fontRevision (16.16 fixed), to three decimals."""
    data = Path(path).read_bytes()
    if len(data) < 12:
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} is not an sfnt font")
    count = struct.unpack(">H", data[4:6])[0]
    for index in range(count):
        tag, _, offset, _ = struct.unpack(">4sIII", data[12 + 16 * index:28 + 16 * index])
        if tag == b"head":
            return f"{struct.unpack('>i', data[offset + 4:offset + 8])[0] / 65536:.3f}"
    raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} has no head table")


def bun_check(found, strict):
    """None when `found` is BUN_LICENSE_VERSION; else Failed under `strict`, or the note."""
    if found == BUN_LICENSE_VERSION:
        return None
    message = (f"bun --version is {found or '(bun not found)'}, but the vendored licence is "
               f"Bun {BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}'s; re-vendor it (tools/licenses/PROVENANCE.md)")
    if strict and MUTANT != "bun-unchecked":
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {message}")
    return message


def _bun_version():
    bun = shutil.which("bun")
    if bun is None:
        return None
    done = subprocess.run([bun, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return done.stdout.strip() if done.returncode == 0 else None


def _crates(root):
    found = {}
    for folder in CARGO_ROOTS:
        argv = ["cargo", "metadata", "--format-version", "1", "--locked", "--offline",
                "--filter-platform", TARGET]
        done = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=str(root / folder), capture_output=True, text=True,
                              timeout=300)
        if done.returncode != 0:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {' '.join(argv)} in {folder}/ exited "
                         f"{done.returncode}: {done.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
        for package in cargo_packages(json.loads(done.stdout)):
            found[package["id"]] = package
    entries = []
    for p in sorted(found.values(), key=lambda p: (p["name"], p["version"])):
        directory = Path(p["manifest_path"]).parent
        if p.get("source") is None:
            relative = os.path.relpath(directory, root)
            note = f" (patched, {PATCHED[p['name']]})" if p["name"] in PATCHED else ""
            source = f"vendored at {relative}{note}"
        elif p["source"].startswith("registry+https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"):
            source = "crates.io"
        else:
            source = p["source"]
        licence = p.get("license") or ""
        texts = licence_texts(directory, p["name"], licence, p.get("authors") or [])
        entries.append(Entry("crate", p["name"], p["version"], licence or "(none declared)",
                             source, texts))
    return entries


def _npm(root):
    agent = root / "agent"
    entries = []
    for name, version in npm_packages(read(agent / "bun.lock")):
        directory = agent / "node_modules" / name
        try:
            manifest = json.loads(read(directory / "package.json"))
        except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/node_modules/{name}/package.json: {error}")
        if manifest.get("version") != version:
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: agent/bun.lock pins {name} {version}, but "
                         f"node_modules holds {manifest.get('version')} (run bun install)")
        licence = manifest.get("license") or ""
        if isinstance(licence, dict):
            licence = licence.get("type", "")
        author = manifest.get("author")
        if isinstance(author, dict):
            author = author.get("name")
        texts = licence_texts(directory, name, licence, [author] if author else [])
        entries.append(Entry("npm", name, version, licence or "(none declared)", "npm", texts))
    return sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e.name)


def _sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license):
    if sparkle_license is None:
        tried = []
        starts = [Path(build_dir)] if build_dir else []
        for start in starts:
            tried += [folder / SPARKLE_LICENSE for folder in [start, *start.parents]]
        tried.append(root / "build" / SPARKLE_LICENSE)
        found = [path for path in tried if path.is_file()]
        if not found:
            raise Failed("acknowledgements: Sparkle's LICENSE is in none of "
                         + ", ".join(map(str, tried)))
        sparkle_license = found[0]
    state_path = Path(sparkle_license).parents[3] / "workspace-state.json"
    try:
        state = json.loads(read(state_path))
        version = [d["state"]["checkoutState"]["version"]
                   for d in state["object"]["dependencies"]
                   if d["packageRef"]["identity"] == "sparkle"][0]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
        raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: no resolved sparkle version in {state_path}: {error!r}")
    return Entry("framework", "sparkle", version, "MIT (with the notices its LICENSE lists)",
                 "https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle",
                 (("LICENSE", read(sparkle_license)),))


def collect(root, build_dir, strict_bun, sparkle_license):
    root = Path(root)
    entries = _crates(root) + _npm(root)
    note = bun_check(_bun_version(), strict_bun)
    if note:
        print(f"warning: {note}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    bun_texts = ((("note", note + "\n"),) if note else ()) + (
        ("LICENSE.md", read(HERE / "bun" / "LICENSE.txt")),)
    entries.append(Entry("runtime", "bun", BUN_LICENSE_VERSION,
                         "MIT; it embeds JavaScriptCore and WebKit (LGPL-2) and the libraries "
                         "its notice lists", f"https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/bun-v"
                         f"{BUN_LICENSE_VERSION}", bun_texts))
    entries.append(_sparkle(root, build_dir, sparkle_license))
    for pin in build_codecs.PINS:
        texts = []
        for _, installed in pin.licenses:
            path = root / "build" / "codecs" / "licenses" / pin.name / installed
            if not path.is_file():
                raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {path} is missing (make codecs)")
            texts.append((installed, read(path)))
        entries.append(Entry("library", pin.name, pin.version, LIBRARY_LICENCES[pin.name],
                             pin.url, tuple(texts)))
    models = root / "app" / "Resources" / "Models"
    tag = re.search(r"tag `v([^`]+)`", read(models / "PROVENANCE.md"))
    if tag is None:
        raise Failed("acknowledgements: no tag `vX` in app/Resources/Models/PROVENANCE.md")
    entries.append(Entry("model", "silero-vad", tag.group(1), "MIT",
                         "https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad",
                         (("LICENSE", read(models / "LICENSE")),)))
    fonts = root / "app" / "Resources" / "Fonts"
    for font in sorted(fonts.glob("*.ttf"), key=lambda p: p.stem):
        ofl = fonts / f"OFL-{font.stem.split('-')[0]}.txt"
        if not ofl.is_file():
            raise Failed(f"acknowledgements: {font.name} has no {ofl.name} beside it")
        entries.append(Entry("font", font.stem, font_revision(font), "OFL-1.1",
                             "vendored at app/Resources/Fonts", ((ofl.name, read(ofl)),)))
    return entries


def render(entries):
    out = ["Frame Job — third-party software notices",
           "Generated at build time by tools/licenses/acknowledgements.py; do not edit.",
           PREAMBLE, ""]
    first = {}
    for e in entries:
        out += [f"== {e.kind} {e.name} {e.version} ==", f"Licence: {e.licence}",
                f"Source: {e.source}"]
        for label, text in e.texts:
            out.append(f"--- {label} ---")
            if text in first:
                out.append(f"(identical to {first[text]}, above)")
            else:
                first[text] = f"{e.kind} {e.name} {e.version}'s {label}"
                out.append(text.rstrip("\n"))
        out.append("")
    return "\n".join(out)


def write(path, text):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    handle, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".acknowledgements-", dir=str(path.parent))
    with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        out.write(text)
    os.chmod(temporary, 0o644)
    os.replace(temporary, path)


# ---- the selftest: no cargo, no network, scratch only ---------------------------------


def selftest(mutant=None):
    global MUTANT
    MUTANT, results = mutant, []

    def row(name, ok, detail):
        results.append((name, bool(ok)))
        print(f"  {'ok  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}", flush=True)

    def failure(call):
        try:
            call()
            return None
        except Failed as error:
            return str(error)

    scratch = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="acknowledgements-selftest-"))
    try:
        entries = [Entry("crate", "a", "1.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("crate", "b", "2.0", "MIT", "crates.io", (("LICENSE", "text a\n"),)),
                   Entry("font", "F-Bold", "1.500", "OFL-1.1", "x", (("OFL-F.txt", "ofl\n"),))]
        one, two = render(entries), render(list(entries))
        row("D0", one == two and one.encode() == two.encode(),
            f"CONTROL: two renders are byte-identical ({len(one)} characters)")
        row("T1", "(identical to crate a 1.0's LICENSE, above)" in one
            and one.count("text a") == 1, "a repeated text becomes the 'identical to' line")

        def node(i, *deps):
            return {"id": i, "deps": [{"pkg": d, "dep_kinds": [{"kind": k}]} for d, k in deps]}
        metadata = {"packages": [{"id": i, "name": i, "version": "1"} for i in
                                 ("framejob-core", "graphic", "lib", "devonly", "buildonly",
                                  "devdeep")],
                    "resolve": {"root": "framejob-core", "nodes": [
                        node("framejob-core", ("graphic", None), ("devonly", "dev"),
                             ("buildonly", "build")),
                        node("graphic", ("lib", None)), node("lib"),
                        node("devonly", ("devdeep", None)), node("buildonly"),
                        node("devdeep")]}}
        names = {p["name"] for p in cargo_packages(metadata)}
        row("G1", "devonly" not in names and "devdeep" not in names
            and not names & set(FIRST_PARTY) and "lib" in names,
            f"dev edges and first-party are excluded: {sorted(names)}")
        row("G2", "buildonly" in names, f"build edges are included: {sorted(names)}")

        lock = """{
  "lockfileVersion": 1,
  "workspaces": { "": { "name": "x", "dependencies": { "a": "^1", },
      "devDependencies": { "dev": "^1", }, }, },
  "packages": {
    "a": ["a@1.2.0", "", { "dependencies": { "b": "^2", }, "peerDependencies": { "p": "^1" },
          "optionalPeers": ["p"], }, "sha512-x"],
    "b": ["b@2.0.1", "", {}, "sha512-y"],
    "dev": ["dev@1.0.0", "", {}, "sha512-z"],
    "p": ["p@1.0.0", "", {}, "sha512-w"],
  }
}"""
        got = npm_packages(lock)
        row("N1", got == [("a", "1.2.0"), ("b", "2.0.1")],
            f"a trailing-comma lock skips dev deps and optional peers: {got}")

        bare = scratch / "bare"
        bare.mkdir()
        texts = licence_texts(bare, "bare", "MIT", ["Ann <ann@example.com>"])
        row("L1", len(texts) == 1 and texts[0][1].startswith("Copyright (c) Ann <ann@example")
            and "Permission is hereby granted" in texts[0][1],
            f"no licence file gives the SPDX text under the authors: {texts[0][0] if texts else None}")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(bare, "bare", "Foo-1.0", []))
        row("L2", why is not None and "bare" in why and "Foo-1.0" in why,
            f"no canonical text fails naming the package and id: {why}")
        nested = scratch / "nested"
        (nested / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
        (nested / "LICENSE").write_text("root\n")
        (nested / "sub" / "COPYING").write_text("nested\n")
        why = failure(lambda: licence_texts(nested, "nested", "MIT", []))
        row("L3", why is not None and "sub/COPYING" in why,
            f"an unlisted nested licence fails, naming it: {why}")
        listed = scratch / "rquickjs-sys"
        for folder in ("quickjs", "vendor/wasi-libc", "crate"):
            (listed / folder).mkdir(parents=True)
        (listed / "quickjs" / "LICENSE").write_text("quickjs\n")
        (listed / "vendor" / "wasi-libc" / "NOTICE.md").write_text("wasi\n")
        (listed / "crate" / "Cargo.toml").write_text("")
        (listed / "crate" / "LICENSE").write_text("own crate\n")
        texts = licence_texts(listed, "rquickjs-sys", "MIT", [])
        labels = [label for label, _ in texts]
        row("L4", "quickjs/LICENSE" in labels and "vendor/wasi-libc/NOTICE.md" not in labels
            and "crate/LICENSE" not in labels,
            f"a listed include is written, an exclude is not: {labels}")

        head = struct.pack(">IIiI", 0x00010000, 0x00018000, 0, 0x5F0F3CF5)
        font = struct.pack(">IHHHH", 0x00010000, 1, 16, 0, 0)
        font += struct.pack(">4sIII", b"head", 0, 28, len(head)) + head
        path = scratch / "font.ttf"
        path.write_bytes(font)
        got = font_revision(path)
        row("F1", got == "1.500", f"the font revision is read from a synthetic sfnt: {got}")

        other = "0.0.1" if BUN_LICENSE_VERSION != "0.0.1" else "0.0.2"
        why = failure(lambda: bun_check(other, True))
        note = bun_check(other, False) if mutant != "bun-unchecked" else bun_check(other, False)
        row("B1", why is not None and other in why and note is not None
            and BUN_LICENSE_VERSION in note and bun_check(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION, True) is None,
            f"a Bun mismatch fails under --strict-bun ({why}) and is noted without it")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(scratch, ignore_errors=True)

    failed = {name for name, ok in results if not ok}
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} rows pass")
    ok = failed == EXPECTED[mutant] if mutant else not failed
    print(f"MUTANT {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}: {mutant} failed {sorted(failed)}, expected "
          f"{sorted(EXPECTED[mutant])}" if mutant else "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="the acknowledgements (#376, spec §11 PUB-10)")
    parser.add_argument("--out", help="where to write Acknowledgements.txt")
    parser.add_argument("--strict-bun", action="store_true",
                        help="fail when bun --version is not BUN_LICENSE_VERSION (Distribution)")
    parser.add_argument("--sparkle-license", help="Sparkle's LICENSE, else found from $BUILD_DIR")
    parser.add_argument("--print-bun-version", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true", help="D0 G1 G2 N1 L1–L4 T1 F1 B1")
    parser.add_argument("--mutant", choices=sorted(EXPECTED))
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if args.selftest or args.mutant:
        return selftest(args.mutant)
    if args.print_bun_version:
        print(BUN_LICENSE_VERSION)
        return 0
    if not args.out:
        parser.error("--out is required")
    try:
        sparkle = Path(args.sparkle_license) if args.sparkle_license else None
        entries = collect(ROOT, os.environ.get("BUILD_DIR"), args.strict_bun, sparkle)
        write(args.out, render(entries))
    except (Failed, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return 1
    print(f"acknowledgements: {len(entries)} entries in {args.out}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
